-- Chiều: Trạng thái công ty
SELECT DISTINCT
    CASE
        WHEN CODE = 'B' THEN 'Đã bị thu hồi'
        WHEN CODE = 'A' THEN 'Hoạt động bình thường'
        WHEN CODE = 'I' THEN 'Kiểm soát đặc biệt'
        WHEN CODE = 'KS' THEN 'Kiểm soát'
        WHEN CODE = 'CB' THEN 'Cảnh báo'
        WHEN CODE = 'S' THEN 'Đình chỉ hoạt động'
        ELSE 'Trạng thái khác'
    END AS trang_thai_ctck
FROM SCMS_UAT.CAT_SC_FIRM_STATUS
WHERE APPLICABLE_ENTITY = 'CTCK' AND RECORD_STATUS = 1
ORDER BY 1;

    COUNT(c.ID) AS tong_ctck_duoc_cap_phep

-- So sánh cùng kỳ năm trước tổng số lượng CTCK đã được cấp phép
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        nd.ngay,
        COUNT(c.ID) AS tong_ctck
    FROM (
        SELECT TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 AS ngay
        FROM (
            SELECT MIN(BUSINESS_LICENSE_DATE) AS min_ngay
            FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO
            WHERE BUSINESS_LICENSE_DATE IS NOT NULL
        )
        CONNECT BY TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
    ) nd
    LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
        ON  c.BUSINESS_LICENSE_DATE IS NOT NULL
        AND TRUNC(c.BUSINESS_LICENSE_DATE) <= nd.ngay
    GROUP BY nd.ngay
)
SELECT
    b1.ngay,
--    b1.tong_ctck AS tong_ctck_nam_nay,
--    b2.tong_ctck AS tong_ctck_nam_truoc,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN b2.tong_ctck = 0 OR b2.tong_ctck IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE (b1.tong_ctck - b2.tong_ctck) / b2.tong_ctck * 100  -- So sánh cùng kỳ năm trước
        END
    , 2) AS so_sanh_cung_ky
FROM base b1
LEFT JOIN base b2
    ON b2.ngay = ADD_MONTHS(b1.ngay, -12)
WHERE b1.ngay = DATE '2026-10-15' -- Test
ORDER BY b1.ngay;

-- Số tài khoản có phát sinh giao dịch
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHD_CTCK'  -- Số lượng tài khoản giao dịch chứng khoán của nhà đầu tư (II.4)
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND fr.LEGAL_BASIS LIKE '%121/2020/TT-BTC%'  -- Thông tư
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )                                   
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'II.4'  -- Check mã sheet
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT t.ID, t.REF_TYPE, t.REF_ID, t.FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT s.ID, s.REF_TYPE, s.REF_ID, s.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY s.REF_TYPE, s.REF_ID, s.FORM_REPORT_ID
                   ORDER BY s.ID DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION s
        WHERE s.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND s.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) t WHERE t.rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.CELL_ID = 'TS046'   -- Tổng cộng số lượng tài khoản có phát sinh giao dịch trong kỳ
),
submission_data AS (
    SELECT
        SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID,
        ngay_bao_cao,
        SUM(numeric_value) AS numeric_value
    FROM (
        SELECT
            p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID,
            ls.FORM_REPORT_ID,
            TRUNC(p.END_DATE) AS ngay_bao_cao,
            cd.numeric_value
        FROM latest_submission ls
        JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = ls.REF_ID
        JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = ls.ID
        WHERE p.END_DATE IS NOT NULL
          AND p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
          AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
    )
    GROUP BY SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID, ngay_bao_cao
),
latest_per_ctck AS (
    SELECT SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, numeric_value
    FROM (
        SELECT
            SC_FIRM_INFO_ID,
            FORM_REPORT_ID,
            ngay_bao_cao,
            numeric_value,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
                ORDER BY ngay_bao_cao DESC, FORM_REPORT_ID DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM submission_data
        WHERE ngay_bao_cao <= DATE '2026-10-23'
    ) WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    SUM(numeric_value) AS so_tk_phat_sinh_giao_dich
FROM latest_per_ctck;

-- Biểu đồ cơ cấu tài sản
WITH
input_form_hn AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCHN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
            AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      )
),
input_form_rl AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCRL'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
            AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      )
),
sheet_hn AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_hn)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06620'-- BÁO CÁO TÌNH HÌNH TÀI CHÍNH HỢP NHẤT
),
sheet_rl AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_rl)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06608' -- BÁO CÁO TÌNH HÌNH TÀI CHÍNH RIÊNG
),
latest_submission_hn AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_hn)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_submission_rl AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_rl)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data_hn AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet_hn)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_hn)
      AND civ.CELL_ID IN ('TS141','TS147','TS149','TS153','TS151','TS273')
),
cell_data_rl AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet_rl)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_rl)
      AND civ.CELL_ID IN ('TS007','TS013','TS015','TS019','TS017','TS133','TS135')
),
-- CTCK đã nộp BCTCHN theo từng kỳ
ctck_co_hn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
),
-- Tính từng CTCK trước khi cộng tổng
ctck_data AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS141' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS tien,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS147' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_qua_lai_lo,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS149' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS nam_giu_dao_han,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS153' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS san_sang_ban,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS151' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS cho_vay,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS273' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS tong_ts
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN cell_data_hn cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCRL cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS007' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS tien,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS013' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS ts_qua_lai_lo,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS015' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS nam_giu_dao_han,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS019' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS san_sang_ban,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS017' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS cho_vay,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS135' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END), 0),
            SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS133' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
        ) AS tong_ts
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN cell_data_rl cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
      AND hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID IS NULL
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
)
-- Cộng tổng toàn thị trường
SELECT
    :p_quy_tu  || '/' || :p_nam_tu AS tu_quy_nam,
    :p_quy_den || '/' || :p_nam_den AS den_quy_nam,
    'Q' || d.PERIOD || '/' || d.REPORT_YEAR AS quy_du_lieu,
    SUM(d.tien) / 1000000000 AS tien_va_tuong_duong_tien,
    SUM(d.ts_qua_lai_lo) / 1000000000 AS tai_san_tai_chinh_qua_lai_lo,
    SUM(d.nam_giu_dao_han) / 1000000000 AS dau_tu_nam_giu_den_ngay_dao_han,
    SUM(d.san_sang_ban) / 1000000000 AS ts_tai_chinh_san_sang_de_ban,
    SUM(d.cho_vay) / 1000000000 AS cac_khoan_cho_vay,
    SUM(d.tong_ts) / 1000000000 AS tong_tai_san,
    (SUM(d.tong_ts) - SUM(d.tien) - SUM(d.ts_qua_lai_lo)
     - SUM(d.nam_giu_dao_han) - SUM(d.san_sang_ban)
     - SUM(d.cho_vay)) / 1000000000 AS tai_san_khac
FROM ctck_data d
GROUP BY d.REPORT_YEAR, d.PERIOD
ORDER BY d.REPORT_YEAR, d.PERIOD;

-- Biểu đồ cơ cấu nguồn vốn
WITH
input_form_hn AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCHN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
            AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      )
),
input_form_rl AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCRL'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
            AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      )
),
sheet_hn AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_hn)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06620'-- BÁO CÁO TÌNH HÌNH TÀI CHÍNH HỢP NHẤT
),
sheet_rl AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_rl)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06608' -- BÁO CÁO TÌNH HÌNH TÀI CHÍNH RIÊNG
),
latest_submission_hn AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_hn)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_submission_rl AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_rl)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data_hn AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet_hn)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_hn)
      AND civ.CELL_ID IN ('TS279','TS323','TS361','TS401')
),
cell_data_rl AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet_rl)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_rl)
      AND civ.CELL_ID IN ('TS141','TS185','TS225','TS261','TS263')
),
-- CTCK đã nộp BCTCHN theo từng kỳ
ctck_co_hn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
),
-- Tính từng CTCK trước khi cộng tổng
ctck_data AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS279' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS vay_va_no_ngan_han,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS323' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS no_phai_tra_dai_han,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS361' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS von_chu_so_huu,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS401' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS tong_nguon_von
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN cell_data_hn cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCRL cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS141' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS vay_va_no_ngan_han,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS185' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS no_phai_tra_dai_han,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS225' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS von_chu_so_huu,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS263' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END), 0),
            SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS261' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
        ) AS tong_nguon_von
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN cell_data_rl cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
      AND hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID IS NULL
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
)
-- Cộng tổng toàn thị trường
SELECT
    :p_quy_tu  || '/' || :p_nam_tu AS tu_quy_nam,
    :p_quy_den || '/' || :p_nam_den AS den_quy_nam,
    'Q' || d.PERIOD || '/' || d.REPORT_YEAR AS quy_du_lieu,
    SUM(d.vay_va_no_ngan_han) / 1000000000 AS vay_va_no_ngan_han,
    SUM(d.no_phai_tra_dai_han) / 1000000000 AS no_phai_tra_dai_han,
    SUM(d.von_chu_so_huu) / 1000000000 AS von_chu_so_huu,
    SUM(d.tong_nguon_von) / 1000000000 AS tong_nguon_von,
    (SUM(d.tong_nguon_von) - SUM(d.vay_va_no_ngan_han) - SUM(d.no_phai_tra_dai_han) - SUM(d.von_chu_so_huu)) / 1000000000 AS nguon_von_khac
FROM ctck_data d
GROUP BY d.REPORT_YEAR, d.PERIOD
ORDER BY d.REPORT_YEAR, d.PERIOD;

-- Chiều thời gian theo ngày
SELECT TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 AS ngay
FROM (
    SELECT LEAST(
        NVL((SELECT MIN(SENT_AT) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_ADHOC_REPORT WHERE SENT_AT IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE),
        NVL((SELECT MIN(CREATED_AT) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_ADHOC_REPORT WHERE CREATED_AT IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE),
        NVL((SELECT MIN(SENT_AT) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT WHERE SENT_AT IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE),
        NVL((SELECT MIN(SUBMISSION_DEADLINE) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT WHERE SUBMISSION_DEADLINE IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE)
    ) AS min_ngay FROM DUAL
)
CONNECT BY TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
ORDER BY ngay;

    AND (
        (p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2) AND TRUNC(p.SENT_AT) <= nd.ngay)
     OR (p.RECORD_STATUS = 0 AND TRUNC(p.CREATED_AT) <= nd.ngay)
    )

-- Biểu đồ Cơ cấu vốn chủ sở hữu
WITH
input_form_hn AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCHN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
            AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      )
),
input_form_rl AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCRL'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
            AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      )
),
sheet_hn AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_hn)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06620'-- BÁO CÁO TÌNH HÌNH TÀI CHÍNH HỢP NHẤT
),
sheet_rl AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_rl)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06608' -- BÁO CÁO TÌNH HÌNH TÀI CHÍNH RIÊNG
),
latest_submission_hn AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_hn)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_submission_rl AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_rl)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data_hn AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet_hn)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_hn)
      AND civ.CELL_ID IN ('TS365','TS389','TS371','TS383','TS385','TS387','TS359')
),
cell_data_rl AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet_rl)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_rl)
      AND civ.CELL_ID IN ('TS229','TS253','TS235','TS247','TS249','TS251','TS223','TS221')
),
-- CTCK đã nộp BCTCHN theo từng kỳ
ctck_co_hn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
),
-- Tính từng CTCK trước khi cộng tổng
ctck_data AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
            SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS365' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS von_gop_csh,
            SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS389' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS loi_nhuan_sau_thue_chua_pp,
            (SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS371' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
                        + SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS383' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
                        + SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS385' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
                        + SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS387' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)) AS quy_thang_du_von_cp,
                SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS359' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS tong_von_csh
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN cell_data_hn cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCRL cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
                SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS229' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS von_gop_csh,
                SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS253' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS loi_nhuan_sau_thue_chua_pp,
                (SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS235' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
                        + SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS247' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
                        + SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS249' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
                        + SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS251' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)) AS quy_thang_du_von_cp,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS223' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END), 0),
            SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS221' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
        ) AS tong_von_csh
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN cell_data_rl cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
      AND hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID IS NULL
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
)
-- Cộng tổng toàn thị trường
SELECT
    :p_quy_tu  || '/' || :p_nam_tu AS tu_quy_nam,
    :p_quy_den || '/' || :p_nam_den AS den_quy_nam,
    'Q' || d.PERIOD || '/' || d.REPORT_YEAR AS quy_du_lieu,
    SUM(d.von_gop_csh) / 1000000000 AS von_gop_csh,
    SUM(d.loi_nhuan_sau_thue_chua_pp) / 1000000000 AS loi_nhuan_sau_thue_chua_pp,
    SUM(d.quy_thang_du_von_cp) / 1000000000 AS quy_thang_du_von_cp,
--    SUM(d.tong_von_csh) / 1000000000 AS tong_von_csh,
    (SUM(d.tong_von_csh) - SUM(d.von_gop_csh) - SUM(d.loi_nhuan_sau_thue_chua_pp) - SUM(d.quy_thang_du_von_cp)) / 1000000000 AS von_csh_khac
FROM ctck_data d
GROUP BY d.REPORT_YEAR, d.PERIOD
ORDER BY d.REPORT_YEAR, d.PERIOD;

-- Chỉ tiêu vốn góp của CSH trên BCTC
WITH
input_form_hn AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCHN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
            AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      )
),
input_form_rl AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCRL'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
            AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      )
),
sheet_hn AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_hn)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06620'-- BÁO CÁO TÌNH HÌNH TÀI CHÍNH HỢP NHẤT
),
sheet_rl AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_rl)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06608' -- BÁO CÁO TÌNH HÌNH TÀI CHÍNH RIÊNG
),
latest_submission_hn AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_hn)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_submission_rl AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_rl)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data_hn AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet_hn)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_hn)
      AND civ.CELL_ID = 'TS365'   -- Vốn góp của chủ sở hữu
),
cell_data_rl AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet_rl)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_rl)
      AND civ.CELL_ID = 'TS229'   -- Vốn góp của chủ sở hữu
),
-- CTCK đã nộp BCTCHN theo từng kỳ
ctck_co_hn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
),
-- Tính từng CTCK trước khi cộng tổng
ctck_data AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
            SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS365' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS von_gop_csh
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN cell_data_hn cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCRL cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
                SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS229' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS von_gop_csh
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN cell_data_rl cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
      AND hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID IS NULL
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
)
-- Cộng tổng toàn thị trường
SELECT
    :p_quy_tu  || '/' || :p_nam_tu AS tu_quy_nam,
    :p_quy_den || '/' || :p_nam_den AS den_quy_nam,
    'Q' || d.PERIOD || '/' || d.REPORT_YEAR AS quy_du_lieu,
    SUM(d.von_gop_csh) / 1000000000 AS von_gop_csh
FROM ctck_data d
GROUP BY d.REPORT_YEAR, d.PERIOD
ORDER BY d.REPORT_YEAR, d.PERIOD;

-- Biểu đồ Nguồn vốn tăng thêm trong kỳ
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(nd.thang, 'MM-YYYY') AS thang_nam,
    -- Chào bán (Cổ phiếu)
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.ITEM_CATEGORY = 'CP'
              AND o.loai_chao_ban = 'CHAO_BAN_RA_CONG_CHUNG'
             THEN o.PROCEEDS_COLLECTED ELSE 0 END) AS chao_ban_cong_chung,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.ITEM_CATEGORY = 'CP'
              AND o.loai_chao_ban = 'CHAO_BAN_RIENG_LE'
             THEN o.PROCEEDS_COLLECTED ELSE 0 END) AS chao_ban_rieng_le,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.ITEM_CATEGORY = 'CP'
              AND o.loai_chao_ban != 'CHAO_BAN_RA_CONG_CHUNG'
              AND o.loai_chao_ban != 'CHAO_BAN_RIENG_LE'
             THEN o.PROCEEDS_COLLECTED ELSE 0 END) AS chao_ban_khac,
    -- Trái phiếu
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.ITEM_CATEGORY = 'TP'
              AND o.loai_chao_ban = 'CHAO_BAN_RIENG_LE'
             THEN o.PROCEEDS_COLLECTED ELSE 0 END) AS trai_phieu_rieng_le,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.ITEM_CATEGORY = 'TP'
              AND o.loai_chao_ban = 'CHAO_BAN_RA_CONG_CHUNG'
             THEN o.PROCEEDS_COLLECTED ELSE 0 END) AS trai_phieu_cong_chung
FROM (
    SELECT ADD_MONTHS(
        TRUNC(TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(:p_nam_tu) || LPAD(TO_CHAR(:p_thang_tu), 2, '0') || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MM'),
        LEVEL - 1
    ) AS thang
    FROM DUAL
    CONNECT BY ADD_MONTHS(
        TRUNC(TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(:p_nam_tu) || LPAD(TO_CHAR(:p_thang_tu), 2, '0') || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MM'),
        LEVEL - 1
    ) <= TRUNC(TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(:p_nam_den) || LPAD(TO_CHAR(:p_thang_den), 2, '0') || '01', 'YYYYMMDD'), 'MM')
) nd
JOIN (
    SELECT
        o.ID,
        o.ITEM_CATEGORY,
        COALESCE(o.DOCUMENT_DATE, o.CREATED_AT) AS ngay_du_lieu,  -- RESULT_REPORT_DATE
        o.PROCEEDS_COLLECTED, 
        JSON_VALUE(o.PLAN_JSON, '$[0].loaiChaoBan') AS loai_chao_ban  -- Lấy loaiChaoBan từ phần tử đầu tiên [0]
    FROM SCMS_UAT.DISCLOSURE_SECURITIES_OFFERING o
    WHERE o.ITEM_CATEGORY IN ('CP', 'TP')
      AND o.PLAN_JSON IS NOT NULL
      AND o.CREATED_AT IS NOT NULL  
) o ON TRUNC(o.ngay_du_lieu, 'MM') = nd.thang
WHERE :p_thang_tu  BETWEEN 1 AND 12
  AND :p_thang_den BETWEEN 1 AND 12
GROUP BY nd.thang
ORDER BY nd.thang;

SELECT
    :p_thang_tu || '/' || :p_nam_tu AS tu_thang_nam,
    :p_thang_den || '/' || :p_nam_den AS den_thang_nam,
    'T' || p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS thang_du_lieu,
--    COUNT(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS006' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS tong,
	COUNT(CASE WHEN cd.numeric_value >= 180 THEN 1 END) AS "An toàn",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cd.numeric_value >= 150 AND cd.numeric_value < 180 THEN 1 END)  AS "Cảnh báo",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cd.numeric_value >= 120 AND cd.numeric_value < 150 THEN 1 END)  AS "Kiểm soát",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN cd.numeric_value < 120 THEN 1 END) AS "Kiểm soát đặc biệt"
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1,2) -- Đúng hạn, Gửi muộn
  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD  = 'THANG'     -- Kỳ tháng
  AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 100 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 100 + :p_thang_tu)  -- tháng có dữ liệu phải >= Từ Tháng/năm
  AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 100 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 100 + :p_thang_den) -- tháng có dữ liệu phải <= Đến Tháng/năm
GROUP BY p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
ORDER BY p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD;

-- Biểu đồ Doanh thu, lợi nhuận sau thuế của CTCK
WITH
input_form_hn AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCHN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
            AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      )
),
input_form_rl AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCRL'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
            AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      )
),
sheet_hn AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_hn)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06622'-- BÁO CÁO KẾT QUẢ HOẠT ĐỘNG HỢP NHẤT
),
sheet_rl AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_rl)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06610' -- BÁO CÁO KẾT QUẢ HOẠT ĐỘNG RIÊNG
),
latest_submission_hn AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_hn)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_submission_rl AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_rl)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data_hn AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet_hn)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_hn)
      AND civ.CELL_ID IN ('TS003','TS011','TS013','TS015','TS017','TS019','TS021','TS023','TS025','TS027','TS029','TS031','TS121')
),
cell_data_rl AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet_rl)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_rl)
      AND civ.CELL_ID IN ('TS003','TS011','TS013','TS015','TS017','TS019','TS021','TS023','TS025','TS027','TS029','TS031','TS119')
),
-- CTCK đã nộp BCTCHN theo từng kỳ
ctck_co_hn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
),
-- Tính từng CTCK trước khi cộng tổng
ctck_data AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCHN' AS loai_bc_nop,
                SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS019' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS doanh_thu_nv_moi_gioi,
                (SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS003' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)        
                        + SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS011' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
                        + SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS015' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
                        + SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS017' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)) AS doanh_thu_nv_tu_doanh,
                (SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS023' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
                        + SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS027' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)) AS doanh_thu_nv_tu_van,
                SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS021' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS doanh_thu_nv_bao_lanh,
                (SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS013' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
                        + SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS025' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
                        + SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS029' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)) AS doanh_thu_nv_khac,
                SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS031' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS doanh_thu,
                SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS121' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS loi_nhuan_sau_thue
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN cell_data_hn cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCRL cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc_nop,
                SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS019' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS doanh_thu_nv_moi_gioi,
                (SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS003' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)        
                        + SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS011' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
                        + SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS015' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
                        + SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS017' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)) AS doanh_thu_nv_tu_doanh,
                (SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS023' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
                        + SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS027' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)) AS doanh_thu_nv_tu_van,
                SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS021' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS doanh_thu_nv_bao_lanh,
                (SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS013' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
                        + SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS025' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
                        + SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS029' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)) AS doanh_thu_nv_khac,
                SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS031' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS doanh_thu,
                SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS119' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS loi_nhuan_sau_thue
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN cell_data_rl cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
      AND hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID IS NULL
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
)
-- Cộng tổng toàn thị trường
SELECT
    'Q' || d.PERIOD || '/' || d.REPORT_YEAR AS quy_du_lieu,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    d.loai_bc_nop AS loai_bao_cao,
    d.doanh_thu_nv_moi_gioi / 1000000000 AS doanh_thu_nv_moi_gioi,
    d.doanh_thu_nv_tu_doanh / 1000000000 AS doanh_thu_nv_tu_doanh,
    d.doanh_thu_nv_tu_van / 1000000000 AS doanh_thu_nv_tu_van,
    d.doanh_thu_nv_bao_lanh / 1000000000 AS doanh_thu_nv_bao_lanh,
    d.doanh_thu_nv_khac / 1000000000 AS doanh_thu_nv_khac,
    d.doanh_thu / 1000000000 AS doanh_thu,
    d.loi_nhuan_sau_thue / 1000000000 AS loi_nhuan_sau_thue
FROM ctck_data d
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = d.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
WHERE c.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'  -- Thay tên CTCK
ORDER BY d.REPORT_YEAR, d.PERIOD, c.SHORT_NAME;

-- Dư nợ margin
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHD_CTCK'  -- Báo cáo tình hình hoạt động công ty chứng khoán
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL  -- Lọc ra ID có dữ liệu nộp báo cáo
            AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'THANG'   -- Lọc ra ID có dữ liệu nộp theo kỳ Quý
      )   
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
            dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
            COLUMNS (
                sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
                sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
            )
         ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'II.8'  -- Tình hình giao dịch ký quỹ chứng khoán
),
latest_submission AS (   -- Lấy submission mới nhất theo từng slot đã nộp
    SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
    WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      AND sub.ID = (
            SELECT MAX(s2.ID) FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION s2
            WHERE s2.REF_TYPE = sub.REF_TYPE AND s2.REF_ID = sub.REF_ID
          )
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.CELL_ID = 'TS024'    -- VII. Tổng dư nợ cho vay giao dịch ký quỹ (V+VI)
)
SELECT
    :p_thang_tu || '/' || :p_nam_tu AS tu_thang_nam,
    :p_thang_den || '/' || :p_nam_den AS den_thang_nam,
    'T' || p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS quy_du_lieu,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS024' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) / 1000000000 AS du_no_margin
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
WHERE 1 = 1
  AND p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1,2) -- Đúng hạn, Gửi muộn
  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD  = 'THANG'     -- Kỳ tháng
  AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 100 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 100 + :p_thang_tu)  -- tháng có dữ liệu phải >= Từ Tháng/năm
  AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 100 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 100 + :p_thang_den) -- tháng có dữ liệu phải <= Đến Tháng/năm

    DATE_FORMAT(nd.thang, 'MM-yyyy') AS thang,
    idx.MARKETINDEX AS chi_so_vn_index
FROM (
    SELECT ADD_MONTHS(MAKE_DATE(:p_nam_tu, :p_thang_tu, 1), pos - 1) AS thang
    FROM (
        SELECT posexplode(split(space(
            (:p_nam_den - :p_nam_tu) * 12 + (:p_thang_den - :p_thang_tu)
        ), ' ')) AS (pos, val)
    )
) nd

    SELECT

        MARKETINDEX,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', TRADINGDATE)
            ORDER BY TRADINGDATE DESC, INDEXTIME DESC, `sequence` DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM (
        SELECT *,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY TRADINGDATE
                   ORDER BY INDEXTIME DESC, `sequence` DESC
               ) AS rn_day
        FROM uat_mdds_stg.jad_marketinfor
        WHERE MARKETCODE = 'HOSE'
    ) t

) idx ON idx.thang = nd.thang
     AND idx.rn = 1

-- Biểu đồ Lưu chuyển tiền thuần từ hoạt động sản xuất kinh doanh (CFO)
WITH
input_form_hn AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCHN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
input_form_rl AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCRL'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
-- Sheet HN: 06622 (BCKQHD HN) + 06623 (BCLCTT HN)
sheet_hn AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId, '06622' AS sheet_code, dc.FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_hn)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06622'  -- BÁO CÁO KẾT QUẢ HOẠT ĐỘNG HỢP NHẤT
    UNION ALL
    SELECT jt.sheetId, '06623' AS sheet_code, dc.FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_hn)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06623'  -- BÁO CÁO LƯU CHUYỂN TIỀN TỆ HỢP NHẤT
),
-- Sheet RL: 06610 (BCKQHD RL) + 06611 (BCLCTT RL)
sheet_rl AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId, '06610' AS sheet_code, dc.FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_rl)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06610'  -- BÁO CÁO KẾT QUẢ HOẠT ĐỘNG RIÊNG
    UNION ALL
    SELECT jt.sheetId, '06611' AS sheet_code, dc.FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_rl)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06611'  -- BÁO CÁO LƯU CHUYỂN TIỀN TỆ RIÊNG
),
latest_submission_hn AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_hn)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_submission_rl AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_rl)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data_hn AS (
    SELECT civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID, civ.CELL_ID, s.sheet_code,
           TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    JOIN sheet_hn s ON s.sheetId = civ.SHEET_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub ON sub.ID = civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID
                                              AND sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = s.FORM_REPORT_ID
    WHERE civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_hn)
      AND ((s.sheet_code = '06622' AND civ.CELL_ID = 'TS121')   -- XI. LỢI NHUẬN KẾ TOÁN SAU THUẾ TNDN (200 = 90 - 100)
        OR (s.sheet_code = '06623' AND civ.CELL_ID = 'TS027'))  -- Lưu chuyển tiền thuần từ hoạt động kinh doanh
),
cell_data_rl AS (
    SELECT civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID, civ.CELL_ID, s.sheet_code,
           TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    JOIN sheet_rl s ON s.sheetId = civ.SHEET_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub ON sub.ID = civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID
                                              AND sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = s.FORM_REPORT_ID
    WHERE civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_rl)
      AND ((s.sheet_code = '06610' AND civ.CELL_ID = 'TS119')   -- XI. LỢI NHUẬN KẾ TOÁN SAU THUẾ TNDN (200 = 90 - 100)
        OR (s.sheet_code = '06611' AND civ.CELL_ID = 'TS027'))  -- Lưu chuyển tiền thuần từ hoạt động kinh doanh
),
-- Năm mới nhất có data cho từng CTCK — BCTCHN
latest_period_hn AS (
    SELECT p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, MAX(p.REPORT_YEAR) AS max_nam
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p
    JOIN latest_submission_hn sub ON sub.REF_ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NAM'
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
),
-- Năm mới nhất có data cho từng CTCK — BCTCRL
latest_period_rl AS (
    SELECT p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, MAX(p.REPORT_YEAR) AS max_nam
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p
    JOIN latest_submission_rl sub ON sub.REF_ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NAM'
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
),
-- CTCK đã nộp BCTCHN
ctck_co_hn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NAM'
),
ctck_data AS (
    -- Nhánh BCTCHN
    SELECT
        p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, 'BCTCHN' AS loai_bc,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd.sheet_code = '06622' AND cd.CELL_ID = 'TS121' THEN cd.numeric_value END) AS lnst,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd.sheet_code = '06623' AND cd.CELL_ID = 'TS027' THEN cd.numeric_value END) AS cfo
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN latest_period_hn lp ON lp.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
                             AND lp.max_nam = p.REPORT_YEAR
    JOIN cell_data_hn cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NAM'
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR

    UNION ALL

    -- Nhánh BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCHN
    SELECT
        p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, 'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd.sheet_code = '06610' AND cd.CELL_ID = 'TS119' THEN cd.numeric_value END) AS lnst,
        MAX(CASE WHEN cd.sheet_code = '06611' AND cd.CELL_ID = 'TS027' THEN cd.numeric_value END) AS cfo
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN latest_period_rl lp ON lp.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
                             AND lp.max_nam = p.REPORT_YEAR
    JOIN cell_data_rl cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NAM'
      AND hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID IS NULL
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR
)
SELECT
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    d.REPORT_YEAR AS nam,
    d.loai_bc AS loai_bao_cao,
    d.lnst / 1000000000 AS lnst,
    d.cfo / 1000000000 AS cfo
FROM ctck_data d
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = d.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
ORDER BY d.REPORT_YEAR, c.SHORT_NAME;

-- Vốn chủ sở hữu
-- Lấy theo kỳ Quý, BTCTRL không có kỳ Tháng
WITH
input_form_hn AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCHN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
            AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      )
),
input_form_rl AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCRL'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
            AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      )
),
sheet_hn AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_hn)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06620'-- BÁO CÁO TÌNH HÌNH TÀI CHÍNH HỢP NHẤT
),
sheet_rl AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_rl)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06608' -- BÁO CÁO TÌNH HÌNH TÀI CHÍNH RIÊNG
),
latest_submission_hn AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_hn)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_submission_rl AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_rl)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data_hn AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet_hn)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_hn)
      AND civ.CELL_ID = 'TS359'  -- VỐN CHỦ SỞ HỮU (400 = 410 + 420)
),
cell_data_rl AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet_rl)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_rl)
      AND civ.CELL_ID IN ('TS223','TS221')  -- VỐN CHỦ SỞ HỮU (400 = 410 + 420)
),
-- CTCK đã nộp BCTCHN theo từng kỳ
ctck_co_hn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
),
-- Tính từng CTCK trước khi cộng tổng
ctck_data AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
                'BCTCHN' AS loai_bc_nop,
                SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS359' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS von_csh
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN cell_data_hn cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
                'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc_nop,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS223' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END), 0),
            SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS221' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
        ) AS von_csh
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN cell_data_rl cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
      AND hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID IS NULL
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
)
-- Cộng tổng toàn thị trường
SELECT
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
        d.loai_bc_nop AS loai_bao_cao,
    'Q' || d.PERIOD || '/' || d.REPORT_YEAR AS quy_du_lieu,
        d.von_csh / 1000000000 AS von_csh
FROM ctck_data d
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = d.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
WHERE c.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'  -- Thay tên CTCK
ORDER BY d.REPORT_YEAR, d.PERIOD, c.SHORT_NAME;

-- Chỉ tiêu vốn CSH trên BCTC
WITH
input_form_hn AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCHN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
            AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      )
),
input_form_rl AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCRL'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
            AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      )
),
sheet_hn AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_hn)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06620'-- BÁO CÁO TÌNH HÌNH TÀI CHÍNH HỢP NHẤT
),
sheet_rl AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_rl)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06608' -- BÁO CÁO TÌNH HÌNH TÀI CHÍNH RIÊNG
),
latest_submission_hn AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_hn)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_submission_rl AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_rl)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data_hn AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet_hn)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_hn)
      AND civ.CELL_ID = 'TS359'  -- VỐN CHỦ SỞ HỮU (400 = 410 + 420)
),
cell_data_rl AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet_rl)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_rl)
      AND civ.CELL_ID IN ('TS223','TS221')  -- VỐN CHỦ SỞ HỮU (400 = 410 + 420)
),
-- CTCK đã nộp BCTCHN theo từng kỳ
ctck_co_hn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
),
-- Tính từng CTCK trước khi cộng tổng
ctck_data AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
                'BCTCHN' AS loai_bc_nop,
                SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS359' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS von_csh
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN cell_data_hn cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
                'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc_nop,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS223' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END), 0),
            SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS221' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
        ) AS von_csh
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN cell_data_rl cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID IS NULL
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
)
-- Cộng tổng toàn thị trường
SELECT
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
        d.loai_bc_nop AS loai_bao_cao,
    'Q' || d.PERIOD || '/' || d.REPORT_YEAR AS quy_du_lieu,
        d.von_csh / 1000000000 AS von_csh
FROM ctck_data d
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = d.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
WHERE c.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'  -- Thay tên CTCK
ORDER BY d.REPORT_YEAR, d.PERIOD, c.SHORT_NAME;

    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
      AND hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID IS NULL
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
)

    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    d.loai_bc_nop AS loai_bao_cao,
    d.tien / 1000000000 AS tien_va_tuong_duong_tien,
    d.ts_qua_lai_lo / 1000000000 AS tai_san_tai_chinh_qua_lai_lo,
    d.nam_giu_dao_han / 1000000000 AS dau_tu_nam_giu_den_ngay_dao_han,
    d.san_sang_ban / 1000000000 AS ts_tai_chinh_san_sang_de_ban,
    d.cho_vay / 1000000000 AS cac_khoan_cho_vay,
    d.tong_ts / 1000000000 AS tong_tai_san,
    (d.tong_ts - d.tien - d.ts_qua_lai_lo
     - d.nam_giu_dao_han - d.san_sang_ban
     - d.cho_vay) / 1000000000 AS tai_san_khac

-- Biểu đồ cơ cấu nguồn vốn CTCK
WITH
input_form_hn AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCHN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
            AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      )
),
input_form_rl AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCRL'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
            AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      )
),
sheet_hn AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_hn)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06620'-- BÁO CÁO TÌNH HÌNH TÀI CHÍNH HỢP NHẤT
),
sheet_rl AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_rl)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06608' -- BÁO CÁO TÌNH HÌNH TÀI CHÍNH RIÊNG
),
latest_submission_hn AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_hn)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_submission_rl AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_rl)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data_hn AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet_hn)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_hn)
      AND civ.CELL_ID IN ('TS279','TS323','TS361','TS401')
),
cell_data_rl AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet_rl)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_rl)
      AND civ.CELL_ID IN ('TS141','TS185','TS225','TS261','TS263')
),
-- CTCK đã nộp BCTCHN theo từng kỳ
ctck_co_hn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
),
-- Tính từng CTCK trước khi cộng tổng
ctck_data AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCHN' AS loai_bc_nop,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS279' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS vay_va_no_ngan_han,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS323' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS no_phai_tra_dai_han,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS361' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS von_chu_so_huu,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS401' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS tong_nguon_von
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN cell_data_hn cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCRL cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc_nop, 
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS141' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS vay_va_no_ngan_han,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS185' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS no_phai_tra_dai_han,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS225' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS von_chu_so_huu,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS263' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END), 0),
            SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS261' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
        ) AS tong_nguon_von
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN cell_data_rl cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
      AND hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID IS NULL
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
)
-- Cộng tổng toàn thị trường
SELECT
    'Q' || d.PERIOD || '/' || d.REPORT_YEAR AS quy_du_lieu,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    d.loai_bc_nop AS loai_bao_cao,
    d.vay_va_no_ngan_han / 1000000000 AS vay_va_no_ngan_han,
    d.no_phai_tra_dai_han / 1000000000 AS no_phai_tra_dai_han,
    d.von_chu_so_huu / 1000000000 AS von_chu_so_huu,
    d.tong_nguon_von / 1000000000 AS tong_nguon_von,
    (d.tong_nguon_von - d.vay_va_no_ngan_han - d.no_phai_tra_dai_han - d.von_chu_so_huu) / 1000000000 AS nguon_von_khac
FROM ctck_data d
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = d.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
WHERE c.SHORT_NAME = 'OCBS'  -- Thay tên CTCK
ORDER BY d.REPORT_YEAR, d.PERIOD, c.SHORT_NAME;
