			+ SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS027' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)) AS doanh_thu_nv_tu_van,
		SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS021' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS doanh_thu_nv_bao_lanh,
		(SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS013' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
			+ SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS025' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
			+ SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS029' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)) AS doanh_thu_nv_khac,
		SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS031' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS doanh_thu,
		SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS121' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS loi_nhuan_sau_thue
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN cell_data_hn cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCRL cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
        'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc_nop,
		SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS019' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS doanh_thu_nv_moi_gioi,
		(SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS003' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)	
			+ SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS011' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
			+ SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS015' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
			+ SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS017' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)) AS doanh_thu_nv_tu_doanh,
		(SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS023' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
			+ SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS027' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)) AS doanh_thu_nv_tu_van,
		SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS021' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS doanh_thu_nv_bao_lanh,
		(SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS013' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
			+ SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS025' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
			+ SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS029' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)) AS doanh_thu_nv_khac,
		SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS031' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS doanh_thu,
		SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS119' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS loi_nhuan_sau_thue
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN cell_data_rl cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
      AND hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID IS NULL
    GROUP BY p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
)
-- Cộng tổng toàn thị trường
SELECT
    'Q' || d.PERIOD || '/' || d.REPORT_YEAR AS quy_du_lieu,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    d.loai_bc_nop AS loai_bao_cao,
    d.doanh_thu_nv_moi_gioi / 1000000000 AS doanh_thu_nv_moi_gioi,
    d.doanh_thu_nv_tu_doanh / 1000000000 AS doanh_thu_nv_tu_doanh,
    d.doanh_thu_nv_tu_van / 1000000000 AS doanh_thu_nv_tu_van,
    d.doanh_thu_nv_bao_lanh / 1000000000 AS doanh_thu_nv_bao_lanh,
    d.doanh_thu_nv_khac / 1000000000 AS doanh_thu_nv_khac,
    d.doanh_thu / 1000000000 AS doanh_thu,
    d.loi_nhuan_sau_thue / 1000000000 AS loi_nhuan_sau_thue
FROM ctck_data d
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = d.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
WHERE c.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'  -- Thay tên CTCK
ORDER BY d.REPORT_YEAR, d.PERIOD, c.SHORT_NAME;

-- Biểu đồ Chỉ số dư nợ margin/vốn CSH CTCK
WITH input_form_margin AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHD_CTCK'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
            AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'THANG'
      )
),
input_form_vcsh_hn AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCHN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
            AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      )
),
input_form_vcsh_rl AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCRL'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
            AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      )
),
sheet_margin AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_margin)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'II.8'  -- Tình hình giao dịch ký quỹ chứng khoán
),
sheet_vcsh_hn AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_vcsh_hn)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06620'  -- BÁO CÁO TÌNH HÌNH TÀI CHÍNH HỢP NHẤT
),
sheet_vcsh_rl AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_vcsh_rl)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06608'  -- BÁO CÁO TÌNH HÌNH TÀI CHÍNH RIÊNG
),
latest_submission_margin AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_margin)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_submission_vcsh_hn AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_vcsh_hn)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_submission_vcsh_rl AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_vcsh_rl)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_margin AS (
    SELECT civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
           TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet_margin)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_margin)
      AND civ.CELL_ID = 'TS024'  -- VII. Tổng dư nợ cho vay giao dịch ký quỹ (V+VI)
),
cell_vcsh_hn AS (
    SELECT civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID, civ.CELL_ID,
           TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet_vcsh_hn)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_vcsh_hn)
      AND civ.CELL_ID = 'TS359'  -- VỐN CHỦ SỞ HỮU (400 = 410 + 420)
),
cell_vcsh_rl AS (
    SELECT civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID, civ.CELL_ID,
           TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet_vcsh_rl)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_vcsh_rl)
      AND civ.CELL_ID IN ('TS223','TS221')  -- VỐN CHỦ SỞ HỮU (400 = 410 + 420)
),
vcsh_map AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        p_v.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p_v.REPORT_YEAR, p_v.PERIOD,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cv.CELL_ID = 'TS359' THEN cv.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS vcsh
    FROM latest_submission_vcsh_hn sub_v
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p_v ON p_v.ID = sub_v.REF_ID
    JOIN cell_vcsh_hn cv ON cv.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub_v.ID
    WHERE p_v.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p_v.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
    GROUP BY p_v.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p_v.REPORT_YEAR, p_v.PERIOD

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không có BCTCHN cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        p_v.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p_v.REPORT_YEAR, p_v.PERIOD,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cv.CELL_ID = 'TS223' THEN cv.numeric_value ELSE 0 END), 0),
            SUM(CASE WHEN cv.CELL_ID = 'TS221' THEN cv.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
        ) AS vcsh
    FROM latest_submission_vcsh_rl sub_v
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p_v ON p_v.ID = sub_v.REF_ID
    JOIN cell_vcsh_rl cv ON cv.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub_v.ID
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT p2.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p2.REPORT_YEAR, p2.PERIOD
        FROM latest_submission_vcsh_hn sub2
        JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p2 ON p2.ID = sub2.REF_ID
        WHERE p2.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
          AND p2.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
    ) hn ON hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = p_v.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
         AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p_v.REPORT_YEAR
         AND hn.PERIOD = p_v.PERIOD
    WHERE p_v.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND p_v.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID IS NULL
    GROUP BY p_v.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p_v.REPORT_YEAR, p_v.PERIOD
)
SELECT
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    'T' || p_m.PERIOD || '/' || p_m.REPORT_YEAR AS thang_du_lieu,
    SUM(cm.numeric_value) / 1000 AS du_no_margin,
    MAX(vm.vcsh) / 1000000000 AS von_csh,
    ROUND(
        (SUM(cm.numeric_value) / 1000)
        / NULLIF(MAX(vm.vcsh) / 1000000000, 0) * 100
    , 6) AS margin_vcsh_pct
FROM latest_submission_margin sub_m
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p_m ON p_m.ID = sub_m.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p_m.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
JOIN cell_margin cm ON cm.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub_m.ID
LEFT JOIN vcsh_map vm ON vm.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = p_m.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
                      AND vm.REPORT_YEAR = p_m.REPORT_YEAR
                      AND vm.PERIOD = CEIL(p_m.PERIOD / 3)
WHERE p_m.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
  AND p_m.REPORT_PERIOD = 'THANG'
  AND (p_m.REPORT_YEAR * 100 + p_m.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 100 + :p_thang_tu)
  AND (p_m.REPORT_YEAR * 100 + p_m.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 100 + :p_thang_den)
  AND c.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'
GROUP BY p_m.REPORT_YEAR, p_m.PERIOD, c.SHORT_NAME
ORDER BY p_m.REPORT_YEAR, p_m.PERIOD;

-- Biểu đồ Tỷ lệ an toàn tài chính
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTLAT'  -- Báo cáo Tỷ lệ an toàn tài chính
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL  -- Lọc ra ID có dữ liệu nộp báo cáo
            AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'THANG'   -- Lọc ra ID có dữ liệu nộp theo kỳ Quý
      )  
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
            dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
            COLUMNS (
                sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
                sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
            )
         ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06H08'  -- BẢNG TỔNG HỢP CÁC CHỈ TIÊU RỦI RO VÀ VỐN KHẢ DỤNG
),
latest_submission AS (   -- Lấy submission mới nhất theo từng slot đã nộp
    SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
    WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      AND sub.ID = (
            SELECT MAX(s2.ID) FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION s2
            WHERE s2.REF_TYPE = sub.REF_TYPE AND s2.REF_ID = sub.REF_ID
          )
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.CELL_ID = 'TS006'  -- Tỷ lệ Vốn khả dụng (6=5/4)
)
SELECT
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    'T' || p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS thang_du_lieu,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cd.CELL_ID = 'TS006' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS ty_le_attc

        COLUMNS (sheetId VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId', sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode')
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_rl)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06608'
),
latest_submission_hn AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_hn)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_submission_rl AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form_rl)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data_hn AS (
    SELECT civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID, civ.CELL_ID, s.sheet_code,
           TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    JOIN sheet_hn s ON s.sheetId = civ.SHEET_ID
    WHERE civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_hn)
      AND ((s.sheet_code = '06622' AND civ.CELL_ID IN ('TS031','TS121'))    -- Doanh thu, LNST
        OR (s.sheet_code = '06620' AND civ.CELL_ID IN ('TS274','TS273','TS360','TS359')))   -- Tổng TS đầu/cuối, VCSH đầu/cuối
),
cell_data_rl AS (
    SELECT civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID, civ.CELL_ID, s.sheet_code,
           TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    JOIN sheet_rl s ON s.sheetId = civ.SHEET_ID
    WHERE civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission_rl)
      AND ((s.sheet_code = '06610' AND civ.CELL_ID IN ('TS031','TS119'))    -- Doanh thu, LNST
        OR (s.sheet_code = '06608' AND civ.CELL_ID IN ('TS136','TS134','TS135','TS133','TS224','TS222','TS223','TS221')))   -- Tổng TS đầu/cuối, VCSH đầu/cuối
),
ctck_co_hn AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD  = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
),
period_data AS (
    -- BCTCHN
    SELECT
        c.SHORT_NAME, sub.ID AS submission_id,
        p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, p.SENT_AT, p.RECORD_STATUS,
        'BCTCHN' AS loai_bc,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.sheet_code = '06622' AND cd.CELL_ID = 'TS031' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS doanh_thu,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.sheet_code = '06622' AND cd.CELL_ID = 'TS121' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS lnst,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.sheet_code = '06620' AND cd.CELL_ID = 'TS274' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS tong_ts_dau_ky,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.sheet_code = '06620' AND cd.CELL_ID = 'TS273' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS tong_ts_cuoi_ky,        
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.sheet_code = '06620' AND cd.CELL_ID = 'TS360' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS vcsh_dau_ky,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.sheet_code = '06620' AND cd.CELL_ID = 'TS359' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS vcsh_cuoi_ky
    FROM latest_submission_hn sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN cell_data_hn cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
      AND c.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'
    GROUP BY c.SHORT_NAME, sub.ID, p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, p.SENT_AT, p.RECORD_STATUS

    UNION ALL

    -- BCTCRL: chỉ CTCK không nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ
    SELECT
        c.SHORT_NAME, sub.ID AS submission_id,
        p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, p.SENT_AT, p.RECORD_STATUS,
        'BCTCRL' AS loai_bc,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.sheet_code = '06610' AND cd.CELL_ID = 'TS031' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS doanh_thu,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cd.sheet_code = '06610' AND cd.CELL_ID = 'TS119' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS lnst,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cd.sheet_code = '06608' AND cd.CELL_ID = 'TS136' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END), 0),
            SUM(CASE WHEN cd.sheet_code = '06608' AND cd.CELL_ID = 'TS134' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
        ) AS tong_ts_dau_ky,		
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cd.sheet_code = '06608' AND cd.CELL_ID = 'TS135' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END), 0),
            SUM(CASE WHEN cd.sheet_code = '06608' AND cd.CELL_ID = 'TS133' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
        ) AS tong_ts_cuoi_ky,        
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cd.sheet_code = '06608' AND cd.CELL_ID = 'TS224' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END), 0),
            SUM(CASE WHEN cd.sheet_code = '06608' AND cd.CELL_ID = 'TS222' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
        ) AS vcsh_dau_ky,		
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN cd.sheet_code = '06608' AND cd.CELL_ID = 'TS223' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END), 0),
            SUM(CASE WHEN cd.sheet_code = '06608' AND cd.CELL_ID = 'TS221' THEN cd.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
        ) AS vcsh_cuoi_ky
    FROM latest_submission_rl sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN cell_data_rl cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    LEFT JOIN ctck_co_hn hn ON hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
                            AND hn.REPORT_YEAR = p.REPORT_YEAR
                            AND hn.PERIOD = p.PERIOD
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD  = 'QUY'
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) >= (:p_nam_tu  * 4 + :p_quy_tu)
      AND (p.REPORT_YEAR * 4 + p.PERIOD) <= (:p_nam_den * 4 + :p_quy_den)
      AND hn.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID IS NULL
      AND c.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'
    GROUP BY c.SHORT_NAME, sub.ID, p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, p.SENT_AT, p.RECORD_STATUS
)
SELECT
    pd.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
--    pd.loai_bc AS loai_bao_cao,
    'Q' || pd.PERIOD || '/' || pd.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_bao_cao,
    SUM(pd.doanh_thu) AS doanh_thu,
    SUM(pd.lnst) AS loi_nhuan,
--    SUM(pd.tong_ts_cuoi_ky) AS tong_ts_cuoi_ky,
--    SUM(pd.tong_ts_dau_ky) AS tong_ts_dau_ky,
--    SUM((pd.tong_ts_cuoi_ky + NVL(pd.tong_ts_dau_ky, pd.tong_ts_cuoi_ky)) / 2) AS tong_ts_binh_quan,    
    ROUND(
        SUM(pd.lnst)
        / NULLIF(SUM((pd.tong_ts_cuoi_ky + NVL(pd.tong_ts_dau_ky, pd.tong_ts_cuoi_ky)) / 2), 0) * 100
    , 2) AS roa_pct,
--    SUM(pd.vcsh_cuoi_ky) AS tong_vcsh_cuoi_ky,
--    SUM(pd.vcsh_dau_ky) AS tong_vcsh_dau_ky,
--    SUM((pd.vcsh_cuoi_ky + NVL(pd.vcsh_dau_ky, pd.vcsh_cuoi_ky)) / 2) AS tong_vcsh_binh_quan,    
    ROUND(
        SUM(pd.lnst)
        / NULLIF(SUM((pd.vcsh_cuoi_ky + NVL(pd.vcsh_dau_ky, pd.vcsh_cuoi_ky)) / 2), 0) * 100
    , 2) AS roe_pct,
    TRUNC(pd.SENT_AT) AS ngay_nop,
    CASE pd.RECORD_STATUS
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Đúng hạn'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Gửi muộn'
    END AS trang_thai    
FROM period_data pd
GROUP BY pd.SHORT_NAME, pd.loai_bc, pd.REPORT_YEAR, pd.PERIOD, pd.SENT_AT, pd.RECORD_STATUS
ORDER BY pd.REPORT_YEAR, pd.PERIOD;

-- Biểu đồ Các chỉ tiêu chung NHNCK
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHD_CTCK'  -- Báo cáo tình hình hoạt động CTCK
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND fr.LEGAL_BASIS LIKE '%121/2020/TT-BTC%'  -- Thông tư
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )                                   
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'TTC_T'  -- Tình hình hoạt động của công ty chứng khoán + kỳ Tháng
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT t.ID, t.REF_TYPE, t.REF_ID, t.FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT s.ID, s.REF_TYPE, s.REF_ID, s.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                   PARTITION BY s.REF_TYPE, s.REF_ID, s.FORM_REPORT_ID
                   ORDER BY s.ID DESC
               ) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION s
        WHERE s.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND s.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) t WHERE t.rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID AS cell_id,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.CELL_ID IN (
          'TS001',   -- 10. Tổng số người lao động tại Công ty
          'TS002'    -- 11. Tổng số người có chứng chỉ hành nghề
      )
),
submission_data AS (
    SELECT
        SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID,
        ngay_bao_cao,
        cell_id,
        SUM(numeric_value) AS numeric_value
    FROM (
        SELECT
            p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID,
            ls.FORM_REPORT_ID,
            TRUNC(p.END_DATE) AS ngay_bao_cao,
            cd.cell_id,
            cd.numeric_value
        FROM latest_submission ls
        JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = ls.REF_ID
        JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
        JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = ls.ID
        WHERE p.END_DATE IS NOT NULL
          AND p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
          AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'THANG'
          AND c.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'  -- Thay tên CTCK
    )
    GROUP BY SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID, ngay_bao_cao, cell_id
),
latest_per_ctck AS (
    SELECT SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, cell_id, numeric_value
    FROM (
        SELECT
            SC_FIRM_INFO_ID,
            FORM_REPORT_ID,
            ngay_bao_cao,
            cell_id,
            numeric_value,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, cell_id
                ORDER BY ngay_bao_cao DESC, FORM_REPORT_ID DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM submission_data
        WHERE ngay_bao_cao <= DATE '2026-10-23'
    ) WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN lpc.cell_id = 'TS001' THEN lpc.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS tong_so_lao_dong,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lpc.cell_id = 'TS002' THEN lpc.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS tong_lao_dong_co_cchn,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lpc.cell_id = 'TS001' THEN lpc.numeric_value ELSE 0 END)
                - SUM(CASE WHEN lpc.cell_id = 'TS002' THEN lpc.numeric_value ELSE 0 END) AS tong_so_lao_dong_chua_co_cchn
FROM latest_per_ctck lpc;

    CONNECT BY LEVEL <= REGEXP_COUNT(CAST(p.POSITION_IDS AS VARCHAR2(4000)), ',') + 1

-- 5. Cổ đông lớn, thành viên góp vốn nắm giữ trên 5% vốn điều lệ
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHD_CTCK'  -- Báo cáo tình hình hoạt động CTCK
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )                                   
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'II.2'  -- Tình hình cổ đông/thành viên góp vốn nắm giữ từ 5% vốn điều lệ
),
latest_submission AS (   -- Lấy submission mới nhất theo từng slot đã nộp
    SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
    WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      AND sub.ID = (
          SELECT MAX(s2.ID) FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION s2
          WHERE s2.REF_TYPE = sub.REF_TYPE
            AND s2.REF_ID   = sub.REF_ID
      )
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS text_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.CELL_ID IN (
          'KT001',   -- Họ và tên (cá nhân)/ Tên tổ chức
          'TS002',   -- Cuối kỳ: Tỷ lệ nắm giữ so với vốn điều lệ
                  'KT006'    -- Cuối kỳ: Số lượng cổ phần/phần vốn góp
      )
),
submission_data AS (
    SELECT
        c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
        TRUNC(p.SENT_AT) AS ngay_bao_cao,
        cd.ROW_NO,
        cd.CELL_ID,
        cd.text_value
    FROM latest_submission sub
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
        JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
    WHERE p.SENT_AT IS NOT NULL
      AND p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1,2) -- Đúng hạn, Gửi muộn
      AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NAM'     -- Kỳ năm
--          AND c.SHORT_NAME = 'CVS'  -- Thay tên CTCK
)
SELECT
    sd.ten_ctck,
    nd.ngay,
    sd.ROW_NO,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sd.CELL_ID = 'KT001' THEN sd.text_value END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY sd.ngay_bao_cao) AS ho_ten,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sd.CELL_ID = 'TS002' THEN sd.text_value END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY sd.ngay_bao_cao) AS ty_le,
        MAX(CASE WHEN sd.CELL_ID = 'KT006' THEN sd.text_value END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY sd.ngay_bao_cao) AS so_luong_co_phan
FROM (
    SELECT TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 AS ngay
    FROM (SELECT MIN(ngay_bao_cao) AS min_ngay FROM submission_data)
    CONNECT BY TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
) nd
LEFT JOIN submission_data sd ON sd.ngay_bao_cao <= nd.ngay
WHERE nd.ngay = DATE '2026-09-07'
GROUP BY nd.ngay, sd.ten_ctck, sd.ROW_NO
HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN sd.CELL_ID = 'KT001' THEN sd.text_value END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY sd.ngay_bao_cao) IS NOT NULL
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN sd.CELL_ID = 'TS002' THEN sd.text_value END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY sd.ngay_bao_cao) IS NOT NULL
   AND MAX(CASE WHEN sd.CELL_ID = 'KT006' THEN sd.text_value END) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY sd.ngay_bao_cao) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY nd.ngay, sd.ten_ctck, sd.ROW_NO;

-- Tổng số CN + PGD + VPĐD trong nước theo nghiệp vụ 
-- CN: Nghiệp vụ: Môi giới, tư vấn, tự doanh, bảo lãnh phát hành
-- PGD: Chỉ đếm PGD có hỗ trợ môi giới, tư vấn
-- VPĐD: Không có các nghiệp vụ này
SELECT
    nd.ngay,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN catalog_code = 'MG'   THEN unit_id END) AS so_cn_pgd_moi_gioi,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN catalog_code = 'BLPH' THEN unit_id END) AS so_cn_pgd_bao_lanh,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN catalog_code = 'TVDT' THEN unit_id END) AS so_cn_pgd_tu_van,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN catalog_code = 'TD'   THEN unit_id END) AS so_cn_pgd_tu_doanh
FROM (
    SELECT TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 AS ngay
    FROM (
        SELECT LEAST(
            NVL((SELECT MIN(DECISION_DATE) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_BRANCH WHERE DECISION_DATE IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE),
            NVL((SELECT MIN(DECISION_DATE) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_TRANSACTION_OFFICE WHERE DECISION_DATE IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE),
            NVL((SELECT MIN(DECISION_DATE) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_REP_OFFICE WHERE DECISION_DATE IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE)
        ) AS min_ngay FROM DUAL
    )
    CONNECT BY TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
) nd
LEFT JOIN (
    -- CN: parse BUSINESS_LINES (CSV của SERVICE_ID) → join CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL
    SELECT
        'CN_' || b.ID AS unit_id,
        b.DECISION_DATE AS decision_date,
        sl.CATALOG_CODE
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_BRANCH b
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = b.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(b.BUSINESS_LINES, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS svc_id
        FROM DUAL
        CONNECT BY LEVEL <= REGEXP_COUNT(b.BUSINESS_LINES, ',') + 1
    ) t ON 1 = 1
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = TO_NUMBER(t.svc_id)
                                               AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                               AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN ('MG','BLPH','TVDT','TD')
    WHERE b.RECORD_STATUS = 1
      AND b.BUSINESS_LINES IS NOT NULL
      AND f.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'  -- Test

    UNION ALL

    -- PGD: Dùng LNK_TRANSACTION_OFFICE_SERVICE
    SELECT
        'PGD_' || t.ID AS unit_id,
        t.DECISION_DATE AS decision_date,
        sl.CATALOG_CODE
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_TRANSACTION_OFFICE t
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = t.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_TRANSACTION_OFFICE_SERVICE lts ON lts.SC_FIRM_TRANSACTION_OFFICE_ID = t.ID
                                                    AND lts.RECORD_STATUS = 1
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lts.SERVICE_ID
                                               AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                               AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN ('MG','TVDT')
    WHERE t.RECORD_STATUS = 1
      AND f.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'  -- Test
	
    UNION ALL

    -- VPĐD: Không có LNK nghiệp vụ → CATALOG_CODE = NULL
    SELECT
        'VPDD_' || r.ID AS unit_id,
        r.DECISION_DATE AS decision_date,
        NULL AS catalog_code  -- Không có nghiệp vụ
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_REP_OFFICE r
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.ID = r.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    WHERE r.RECORD_STATUS = 1
      AND f.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'  -- Test

) units ON TRUNC(units.decision_date) <= nd.ngay
WHERE nd.ngay = DATE '2026-09-11'
GROUP BY nd.ngay
ORDER BY nd.ngay;

-- VPĐD: Không có các dịch vụ này
SELECT
    nd.ngay,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN catalog_code = '02' THEN unit_id END) AS so_cn_pgd_vpdd_giao_dich_ky_quy,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN catalog_code = '01' THEN unit_id END) AS so_cn_pgd_vpdd_ung_truoc_tien_ban,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN catalog_code = '04' THEN unit_id END) AS so_cn_pgd_vpdd_luu_ky
FROM (
    SELECT TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 AS ngay
    FROM (
        SELECT LEAST(
            NVL((SELECT MIN(DECISION_DATE) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_BRANCH WHERE DECISION_DATE IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE),
            NVL((SELECT MIN(DECISION_DATE) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_TRANSACTION_OFFICE WHERE DECISION_DATE IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE),
            NVL((SELECT MIN(DECISION_DATE) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_REP_OFFICE WHERE DECISION_DATE IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE)
        ) AS min_ngay FROM DUAL
    )
    CONNECT BY TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
) nd
LEFT JOIN (
    -- CN: parse BUSINESS_LINES (CSV của SERVICE_ID) → join CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL
    SELECT
        'CN_' || b.ID AS unit_id,
        b.DECISION_DATE AS decision_date,
        sl.CATALOG_CODE
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_BRANCH b
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = b.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(b.BUSINESS_LINES, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS svc_id
        FROM DUAL
        CONNECT BY LEVEL <= REGEXP_COUNT(b.BUSINESS_LINES, ',') + 1
    ) t ON 1 = 1
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = TO_NUMBER(t.svc_id)
                                               AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                               AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN ('02', '01', '04')
    WHERE b.RECORD_STATUS = 1
      AND b.BUSINESS_LINES IS NOT NULL
      AND f.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'  -- Test

    UNION ALL

    -- PGD: Dùng LNK_TRANSACTION_OFFICE_SERVICE
    SELECT
        'PGD_' || t.ID AS unit_id,
        t.DECISION_DATE AS decision_date,
        sl.CATALOG_CODE
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_TRANSACTION_OFFICE t
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = t.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_TRANSACTION_OFFICE_SERVICE lts ON lts.SC_FIRM_TRANSACTION_OFFICE_ID = t.ID
                                                    AND lts.RECORD_STATUS = 1
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lts.SERVICE_ID
                                               AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                               AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN ('LKCK')
    WHERE t.RECORD_STATUS = 1
      AND f.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'  -- Test
	
    UNION ALL

    -- VPĐD: Không có LNK nghiệp vụ → CATALOG_CODE = NULL
    SELECT
        'VPDD_' || r.ID AS unit_id,
        r.DECISION_DATE AS decision_date,
        NULL AS catalog_code  -- Không có nghiệp vụ
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_REP_OFFICE r
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.ID = r.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    WHERE r.RECORD_STATUS = 1
      AND f.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'  -- Test

) units ON TRUNC(units.decision_date) <= nd.ngay
WHERE nd.ngay = DATE '2026-09-11'
GROUP BY nd.ngay
ORDER BY nd.ngay;

-- Danh sách CN, PGD, VPĐD trong nước (Tên CN, PGD, VPĐD; Địa chỉ; Nghiệp vụ; Ngày thành lập; Giám đốc chi nhánh/Trưởng VPĐD)
WITH nghiep_vu_cn AS (
    -- CN: parse BUSINESS_LINES → CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL
    SELECT
        b.ID AS branch_id,
        LISTAGG(sl.SERVICE_NAME, ', ')
            WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.SERVICE_NAME) AS danh_sach_nghiep_vu
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_BRANCH b
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(b.BUSINESS_LINES, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS svc_id
        FROM DUAL
        CONNECT BY LEVEL <= REGEXP_COUNT(b.BUSINESS_LINES, ',') + 1
    ) t ON 1 = 1
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = TO_NUMBER(t.svc_id)
                                               AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                               AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN ('MG','BLPH','TVDT','TD')
    WHERE b.RECORD_STATUS = 1
      AND b.BUSINESS_LINES IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY b.ID
),
nghiep_vu_pgd AS (
    -- PGD: LNK_TRANSACTION_OFFICE_SERVICE
    SELECT
        t.ID AS office_id,
        LISTAGG(sl.SERVICE_NAME, ', ')
            WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.SERVICE_NAME) AS danh_sach_nghiep_vu
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_TRANSACTION_OFFICE t
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_TRANSACTION_OFFICE_SERVICE lts ON lts.SC_FIRM_TRANSACTION_OFFICE_ID = t.ID
                                                     AND lts.RECORD_STATUS = 1
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lts.SERVICE_ID
                                               AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                               AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN ('MG','TVDT')
    WHERE t.RECORD_STATUS = 1
    GROUP BY t.ID
)
SELECT
    'Chi nhánh' AS loai,
    NVL(b.BRANCH_NAME, b.FULL_NAME) AS ten,
    b.ADDRESS AS dia_chi,
    nv.danh_sach_nghiep_vu AS nghiep_vu,
    TRUNC(b.DECISION_DATE) AS ngay_thanh_lap,
    TO_NCHAR(b.REPRESENTATIVE_NAME) AS giam_doc_hoac_truong_vpdd
FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_BRANCH b
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = b.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nghiep_vu_cn nv ON nv.branch_id = b.ID
WHERE b.RECORD_STATUS = 1
  AND f.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'  -- Test

UNION ALL
SELECT
    'Phòng giao dịch' AS loai,
    NVL(t.TRANSACTION_OFFICE_NAME, t.FULL_NAME) AS ten,
    t.ADDRESS AS dia_chi,
    nv.danh_sach_nghiep_vu AS nghiep_vu,
    TRUNC(t.DECISION_DATE) AS ngay_thanh_lap,
    t.REPRESENTATIVE_NAME  AS giam_doc_hoac_truong_vpdd
FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_TRANSACTION_OFFICE t
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = t.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nghiep_vu_pgd nv ON nv.office_id = t.ID
WHERE t.RECORD_STATUS = 1
  AND f.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'  -- Test

UNION ALL
SELECT
    'Văn phòng đại diện' AS loai,
    NVL(r.OFFICE_NAME, r.FULL_NAME) AS ten,
    r.ADDRESS AS dia_chi,
    NULL AS nghiep_vu,
    TRUNC(r.DECISION_DATE) AS ngay_thanh_lap,
    r.REPRESENTATIVE_NAME  AS giam_doc_hoac_truong_vpdd
FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_REP_OFFICE r
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.ID = r.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
WHERE r.RECORD_STATUS = 1
  AND f.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'  -- Test

ORDER BY loai, ngay_thanh_lap;

--  Lịch sử nộp báo cáo của CTCK (Tên báo cáo, Kỳ kê khai, Hạn nộp, Ngày nộp, Trạng thái)
SELECT
    r.loai_bao_cao,
    r.ten_bao_cao,
    r.ky_ke_khai,
    r.han_nop,
    r.ngay_nop,
    r.trang_thai
FROM (
    SELECT TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 AS ngay
    FROM (
        SELECT LEAST(
            NVL((SELECT MIN(TRUNC(SENT_AT)) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT WHERE SENT_AT IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE),
            NVL((SELECT MIN(TRUNC(SENT_AT)) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_ADHOC_REPORT WHERE SENT_AT IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE)
        ) AS min_ngay FROM DUAL
    )
    CONNECT BY TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
) nd
LEFT JOIN (
    -- Báo cáo định kỳ
    SELECT
        N'Báo cáo định kỳ' AS loai_bao_cao,
        r.REPORT_NAME AS ten_bao_cao,
        CASE r.REPORT_PERIOD
            WHEN 'NGAY' THEN N'Ngày ' || TO_NCHAR(r.SENT_AT, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
            WHEN 'TUAN' THEN N'Tuần ' || TO_NCHAR(r.PERIOD) || N'/' || TO_NCHAR(r.REPORT_YEAR)
            WHEN 'THANG' THEN N'Tháng ' || TO_NCHAR(r.PERIOD) || N'/' || TO_NCHAR(r.REPORT_YEAR)
            WHEN 'QUY' THEN N'Quý ' || TO_NCHAR(r.PERIOD) || N'/' || TO_NCHAR(r.REPORT_YEAR)
            WHEN 'BAN_NIEN' THEN N'Bán niên ' || TO_NCHAR(r.REPORT_YEAR)
            WHEN 'NAM' THEN N'Năm ' || TO_NCHAR(r.REPORT_YEAR)
            ELSE TO_NCHAR(r.REPORT_PERIOD)
        END AS ky_ke_khai,
        TRUNC(r.SUBMISSION_DEADLINE) AS han_nop,
        TRUNC(r.SENT_AT) AS ngay_nop,
        CASE
            WHEN r.RECORD_STATUS = 1 THEN N'Đúng hạn'
            WHEN r.RECORD_STATUS = 2 THEN N'Trễ hạn'
        END AS trang_thai,
        r.SENT_AT
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT r
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.ID = r.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    WHERE r.RECORD_STATUS IN (1,2) -- Đúng hạn, Gửi muộn
      AND r.SENT_AT IS NOT NULL
    --  AND f.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'

    UNION ALL

    -- Báo cáo đột xuất
    SELECT
        N'Báo cáo đột xuất' AS loai_bao_cao,
        TO_NCHAR(p.REPORT_NAME) AS ten_bao_cao,
        p.PERIOD_VALUE AS ky_ke_khai,
        TRUNC(p.SUBMISSION_DEADLINE) AS han_nop,
        TRUNC(p.SENT_AT) AS ngay_nop,
        CASE
            WHEN p.RECORD_STATUS = 1 THEN N'Đúng hạn'
            WHEN p.RECORD_STATUS = 2 THEN N'Trễ hạn'
        END AS trang_thai,
        p.SENT_AT
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_ADHOC_REPORT p
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)  -- Đúng hạn, Gửi muộn
      AND p.SENT_AT IS NOT NULL
    --  AND f.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'
) r ON TRUNC(r.SENT_AT) <= nd.ngay
WHERE nd.ngay = DATE '2026-09-11'
ORDER BY r.SENT_AT DESC, r.loai_bao_cao;

        SELECT MIN(pd.ISSUED_DATE) AS min_ngay
        FROM THANHTRA_UAT.PENALTY_DECISION pd
        WHERE pd.DELETED       = 0
          AND pd.ISSUED_DATE IS NOT NULL
    )
    CONNECT BY TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
) nd
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        pds.SUBJECT_TAX_CODE,
        pd.ISSUED_DATE AS issued_date,
        pd.DECISION_NUMBER,
        vb.NAME AS hanh_vi,
        CASE WHEN pt.CATEGORY = 'SUPPLEMENTARY_PENALTY' THEN pt.NAME END AS xu_phat_bo_sung,
        CASE WHEN pt.CATEGORY = 'REMEDIAL_MEASURE' THEN pt.NAME END AS bp_khac_phuc
    FROM THANHTRA_UAT.PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT pds
    LEFT JOIN THANHTRA_UAT.PENALTY_DECISION pd ON pd.ID = pds.PENALTY_DECISION_ID
                                               AND pd.DELETED = 0
    LEFT JOIN THANHTRA_UAT.PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT_BEHAVIOR pdsb ON pdsb.PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT_ID = pds.ID
                                                                  AND pdsb.DELETED = 0
    LEFT JOIN THANHTRA_UAT.VIOLATION_BEHAVIOR vb ON vb.ID = pdsb.VIOLATION_BEHAVIOR_ID
                                                 AND vb.DELETED = 0
    LEFT JOIN THANHTRA_UAT.PENALTY_TYPE pt ON pt.ID = pdsb.PENALTY_TYPE_ID
                                           AND pt.DELETED = 0
                                           AND pt.STATUS  = 'ACTIVE'
    WHERE pds.DELETED = 0
      AND pd.ISSUED_DATE IS NOT NULL
) sd ON sd.issued_date <= nd.ngay

-- Chiều thời gian theo ngày
SELECT TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 AS ngay
FROM (
    SELECT LEAST(
        NVL((SELECT MIN(APPOINTMENT_DATE) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SENIOR_PERSONNEL WHERE APPOINTMENT_DATE IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE),
        NVL((SELECT MIN(CREATED_AT) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SHAREHOLDER WHERE CREATED_AT IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE),
        NVL((SELECT MIN(RELATION_START_DATE) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INSIDER_RELATION WHERE RELATION_START_DATE  IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE),
        NVL((SELECT MIN(RELATION_START_DATE) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_MAJOR_SHAREHOLDER_RELATION WHERE RELATION_START_DATE IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE),
        NVL((SELECT MIN(effective_from_date) FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.company_entity_role WHERE effective_from_date IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE),
        NVL((SELECT MIN(appointment_date) FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.positions WHERE appointment_date IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE),
        NVL((SELECT MIN(S_WORK_DTE) FROM FMS_UAT.INSIDER WHERE S_WORK_DTE IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE)
    ) AS min_ngay FROM DUAL
)
CONNECT BY TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
ORDER BY ngay;

-- Dashboard Mạng lưới của cá nhân ban quản trị, điều hành, cổ đông tại CTCK
-- Query 1 - Thông tin của "cá nhân" (node trung tâm) tại 1 CTCK
WITH
nd AS (
    SELECT TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 AS ngay
    FROM (
        SELECT LEAST(
            NVL((SELECT MIN(APPOINTMENT_DATE) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SENIOR_PERSONNEL WHERE APPOINTMENT_DATE IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE),
            NVL((SELECT MIN(CREATED_AT) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SHAREHOLDER WHERE CREATED_AT IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE)
        ) AS min_ngay FROM DUAL
    )
    CONNECT BY TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
),
individuals AS (
  SELECT
    nd.ngay,
    'BQT_BĐH' AS source_track,
    TO_CHAR(f.SHORT_NAME) AS ten_ctck,
    TO_CHAR(sp.FULL_NAME) AS ho_ten,
    TO_CHAR(sp.NATIONAL_ID) AS cccd,
    TO_CHAR(
      NVL(
        (SELECT LISTAGG(cp2.POSITION_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cp2.POSITION_NAME)
         FROM SCMS_UAT.CAT_POSITION cp2
         WHERE cp2.ID IN (
             SELECT TO_NUMBER(TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(CAST(sp.POSITION_IDS AS VARCHAR2(4000)), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR)
           FROM DUAL
             CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(CAST(sp.POSITION_IDS AS VARCHAR2(4000)), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL
         )
        ),
        sp.POSITION
      )
    ) AS chuc_vu,
    sp.APPOINTMENT_DATE AS ngay_bo_nhiem,
    sp.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS ngay_sinh,
    FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(SYSDATE), sp.DATE_OF_BIRTH) / 12) AS tuoi,
    TO_CHAR(nat.NATIONALITY_NAME) AS quoc_tich,
    TO_CHAR(sp.SHAREHOLDER_TYPE) AS shareholder_type
  FROM nd
  JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SENIOR_PERSONNEL sp
    ON sp.APPOINTMENT_DATE <= nd.ngay
   AND (sp.DISMISSAL_DATE IS NULL OR sp.DISMISSAL_DATE > nd.ngay)
  JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = sp.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
  LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_NATIONALITY nat ON nat.ID = sp.NATIONALITY_ID
  WHERE 1 = 1
--    AND sp.ENTITY_TYPE = 'CA_NHAN'
--    AND sp.NATIONAL_ID = '45656666'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    nd.ngay,  
    'CO_DONG' AS source_track,
    TO_CHAR(f.SHORT_NAME) AS ten_ctck,
    TO_CHAR(sh.SHAREHOLDER_NAME) AS ho_ten,
    TO_CHAR(sh.ID_NUMBER) AS cccd,
    TO_CHAR(sh.SHAREHOLDER_TYPE) AS chuc_vu,
    sh.ISSUE_DATE AS ngay_bo_nhiem,
    sh.DATE_OF_BIRTH AS ngay_sinh,
    FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(SYSDATE), sh.DATE_OF_BIRTH) / 12) AS tuoi,
    TO_CHAR(nat.NATIONALITY_NAME) AS quoc_tich,
    TO_CHAR(sh.SHAREHOLDER_TYPE) AS shareholder_type
  FROM nd
  JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SHAREHOLDER sh
    ON TRUNC(sh.CREATED_AT) <= nd.ngay
   AND sh.RECORD_STATUS = 1
  JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = sh.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
  LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_NATIONALITY nat ON nat.ID = sh.NATIONALITY_ID
  WHERE 1 = 1 
--    AND sh.SHAREHOLDER_ENTITY_TYPE = 'CA_NHAN'
--    AND f.SHORT_NAME = 'SSI'
--    AND sh.ID_NUMBER = '45656666'  
)
SELECT
  ten_ctck,
  ngay_bo_nhiem,
  ho_ten,
  chuc_vu,  
  ngay_sinh,
  tuoi,
  quoc_tich,  
  cccd,
  CASE
    WHEN shareholder_type IN ('CDL', 'CO_DONG_LON') THEN 'Cổ đông lớn'
    WHEN shareholder_type IN ('CDSL', 'CO_DONG_SANG_LAP') THEN 'Cổ đông sáng lập'
    WHEN source_track = 'BQT_BĐH' THEN 'Người nội bộ'
    ELSE 'Khác'
  END AS vai_tro_tong_hop
FROM individuals
WHERE ngay = DATE '2026-09-11'   -- NGÀY DỮ LIỆU
ORDER BY ten_ctck, ho_ten;

-- Query 2 - Node "Người liên quan" của 1 cá nhân đã chọn (theo CCCD)
WITH
nd AS (
    SELECT TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 AS ngay
    FROM (
        SELECT LEAST(
            NVL((SELECT MIN(RELATION_START_DATE) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INSIDER_RELATION WHERE RELATION_START_DATE IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE),
            NVL((SELECT MIN(RELATION_START_DATE) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_MAJOR_SHAREHOLDER_RELATION WHERE RELATION_START_DATE IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE)
        ) AS min_ngay FROM DUAL
    )
    CONNECT BY TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
)
SELECT
  nd.ngay,
  'NGUOI_NOI_BO_LIEN_QUAN' AS nguon,
  TO_CHAR(f.SHORT_NAME) AS ten_ctck,
  TO_CHAR(sp.FULL_NAME) AS ho_ten_ca_nhan,
  TO_CHAR(sp.NATIONAL_ID) AS cccd_ca_nhan,
  TO_CHAR(r.FULL_NAME) AS ho_ten_nguoi_lien_quan,
  TO_CHAR(r.RELATIONSHIP) AS moi_quan_he,
  TO_CHAR(
      (SELECT LISTAGG(cp2.POSITION_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cp2.POSITION_NAME)
       FROM SCMS_UAT.CAT_POSITION cp2
       WHERE cp2.ID IN (
           SELECT TO_NUMBER(TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(CAST(sp.POSITION_IDS AS VARCHAR2(4000)), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR)
         FROM DUAL
           CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(CAST(sp.POSITION_IDS AS VARCHAR2(4000)), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL
       )
      )
  ) AS chuc_vu,
  r.SHARES_COUNT AS so_cp_nam_giu,
  r.OWNERSHIP_RATIO AS ty_le_so_huu
FROM nd
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INSIDER_RELATION r
  ON TRUNC(r.CREATED_AT) <= nd.ngay
 AND r.RECORD_STATUS = 1
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SENIOR_PERSONNEL sp
  ON sp.ID = r.SENIOR_PERSONNEL_ID
 AND sp.APPOINTMENT_DATE <= nd.ngay
 AND (sp.DISMISSAL_DATE IS NULL OR sp.DISMISSAL_DATE > nd.ngay)
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = sp.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_RELATED_PERSON rp
  ON rp.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = sp.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
 AND UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(rp.IDENTIFICATION_NUMBER), '[^0-9A-Za-z]', ''))
   = UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(r.NATIONAL_ID), '[^0-9A-Za-z]', ''))
WHERE nd.ngay = DATE '2026-09-11'   -- NGÀY DỮ LIỆU
--  AND sp.NATIONAL_ID = '45656666'  -- CCCD "cá nhân"

UNION ALL

SELECT
  nd.ngay,
  'CO_DONG_LON_LIEN_QUAN' AS nguon,
  TO_CHAR(f.SHORT_NAME) AS ten_ctck,
  TO_CHAR(sh.SHAREHOLDER_NAME) AS ho_ten_ca_nhan,
  TO_CHAR(sh.ID_NUMBER) AS cccd_ca_nhan,
  TO_CHAR(mr.FULL_NAME) AS ho_ten_nguoi_lien_quan,
  TO_CHAR(mr.RELATIONSHIP) AS moi_quan_he,
  TO_CHAR(sh.SHAREHOLDER_TYPE) AS chuc_vu,
  mr.SHARES_COUNT AS so_cp_nam_giu,
  mr.OWNERSHIP_RATIO AS ty_le_so_huu
FROM nd
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_MAJOR_SHAREHOLDER_RELATION mr
  ON TRUNC(mr.CREATED_AT) <= nd.ngay
 AND (mr.RELATION_END_DATE IS NULL OR mr.RELATION_END_DATE > nd.ngay)
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SHAREHOLDER sh
  ON sh.ID = mr.SHAREHOLDER_ID
 AND TRUNC(sh.CREATED_AT) <= nd.ngay
 AND sh.RECORD_STATUS = 1
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = mr.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
WHERE nd.ngay = DATE '2026-09-11'   -- NGÀY DỮ LIỆU
--  AND sh.ID_NUMBER = '45656666' -- CCCD
  
ORDER BY 3, 4, 6;

-- Query 3 - Node "Tổ chức liên quan" (CTCK/CTĐC/CT QLQ) mà "cá nhân" hoặc "người liên quan" đang giữ vai trò
WITH nd AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-09-11' AS ngay FROM DUAL
)
SELECT
  nd.ngay,
  UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(TO_CHAR(sp.NATIONAL_ID)), '[^0-9A-Za-z]', '')) AS cccd,
  TO_CHAR(sp.FULL_NAME) AS ho_ten,
  TO_CHAR(f.SHORT_NAME) AS ten_to_chuc,
  'CTCK' AS loai_to_chuc,
  TO_CHAR(
    NVL(
      (SELECT LISTAGG(cp2.POSITION_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cp2.POSITION_NAME)
       FROM SCMS_UAT.CAT_POSITION cp2
       WHERE cp2.ID IN (
           SELECT TO_NUMBER(TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(CAST(sp.POSITION_IDS AS VARCHAR2(4000)), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR)
         FROM DUAL
           CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(CAST(sp.POSITION_IDS AS VARCHAR2(4000)), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL
       )
      ),
      sp.POSITION
    )
  ) AS vai_tro,
  CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS so_cp_nam_giu,
  CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS ty_le_so_huu
FROM nd
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SENIOR_PERSONNEL sp
  ON sp.APPOINTMENT_DATE <= nd.ngay
 AND (sp.DISMISSAL_DATE IS NULL OR sp.DISMISSAL_DATE > nd.ngay)
 AND sp.NATIONAL_ID IS NOT NULL
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = sp.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
WHERE sp.NATIONAL_ID IS NOT NULL
--  AND sp.ENTITY_TYPE = 'CA_NHAN'
--  AND sp.NATIONAL_ID = '45656666'  -- CCCD của cá nhân hoặc người liên quan

UNION ALL

SELECT
  nd.ngay,
  UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(TO_CHAR(sh.ID_NUMBER)), '[^0-9A-Za-z]', '')) AS cccd,
  TO_CHAR(sh.SHAREHOLDER_NAME) AS ho_ten,
  TO_CHAR(f.SHORT_NAME) AS ten_to_chuc,
  'CTCK' AS loai_to_chuc,
  CASE
    WHEN sh.SHAREHOLDER_TYPE IN ('CDL', 'CO_DONG_LON') THEN 'Cổ đông lớn'
    WHEN sh.SHAREHOLDER_TYPE IN ('CDSL', 'CO_DONG_SANG_LAP') THEN 'Cổ đông sáng lập'
    ELSE 'Khác'
  END AS vai_tro,
  sh.SHARES_HELD AS so_cp_nam_giu,
  sh.OWNERSHIP_RATIO AS ty_le_so_huu
FROM nd
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SHAREHOLDER sh
  ON TRUNC(sh.CREATED_AT) <= nd.ngay
 AND sh.RECORD_STATUS = 1
 AND sh.ID_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = sh.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
WHERE sh.ID_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
--  AND sh.SHAREHOLDER_ENTITY_TYPE = 'CA_NHAN'
--  AND sh.ID_NUMBER = '45656666' -- CCCD

UNION ALL

SELECT
  nd.ngay,
  UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(TO_CHAR(i.ID_NO)), '[^0-9A-Za-z]', '')) AS cccd,
  TO_CHAR(i.ITEM_NAME) AS ho_ten,
  TO_CHAR(sec.SHORT_NAME) AS ten_to_chuc,
  'CT QLQ' AS loai_to_chuc,
  TO_CHAR(
    CASE i.INSIDER_TYPE
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Cổ đông lớn'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Ban điều hành'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'HĐQT'
    END
  ) AS vai_tro,
  i.QTTY AS so_cp_nam_giu,
  i.REPRECENT AS ty_le_so_huu
FROM nd
JOIN FMS_UAT.INSIDER i
  ON TRUNC(i.S_WORK_DTE) <= nd.ngay
 AND i.RECORD_STATUS = 1
 AND i.ID_NO IS NOT NULL
 AND i.INSIDER_TYPE IN (1,2,3)
-- AND i.ID_NO = '123456'
JOIN FMS_UAT.SECURITIES sec ON sec.ID = i.SC_ID
--WHERE i.ID_NO = '45656666'  -- CCCD

UNION ALL

SELECT
  nd.ngay,
  UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(TO_CHAR(idt.identity_no)), '[^0-9A-Za-z]', '')) AS cccd,
  TO_CHAR(le.entity_name) AS ho_ten,
  TO_CHAR(cp2.equity_ticker) AS ten_to_chuc,
  'CTĐC' AS loai_to_chuc,
  CASE
      WHEN posx.vai_tro IS NOT NULL THEN posx.vai_tro
      WHEN cer.role_type_cd = 'NNB' THEN 'Người nội bộ'
      WHEN cer.role_type_cd = 'CD'  THEN 'Cổ đông'
      ELSE 'Khác'
  END AS vai_tro,
  csh.ownership_qty AS so_cp_nam_giu,
  csh.ownership_ratio AS ty_le_so_huu
FROM nd
JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.identity idt
  ON idt.identity_no IS NOT NULL
 AND idt.delete_flg = 0
-- AND idt.identity_no = '123456'
JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.legal_entities le ON le.id = idt.legal_entity_id AND le.delete_flg = 0
LEFT JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.company_entity_role cer
       ON cer.legal_entity_id = le.id
      AND cer.delete_flg = 0
      AND cer.effective_from_date <= nd.ngay
      AND (cer.effective_to_date IS NULL OR cer.effective_to_date > nd.ngay)
OUTER APPLY (
  SELECT
    LISTAGG(NVL(lv.lookup_value_vn, p.position_cd), ', ')
      WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.appointment_date DESC) AS vai_tro
  FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.positions p
  LEFT JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.lookup_values lv
         ON lv.lookup_cd = p.position_cd AND lv.LOOKUP_GROUP = 'POSITION'
  WHERE p.legal_entity_id = le.id
    AND p.delete_flg = 0
    AND p.appointment_date <= nd.ngay
    AND (p.dismissal_date IS NULL OR p.dismissal_date > nd.ngay)
) posx

-- Vai trò tại DN niêm yết
WITH nd AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-09-11' AS ngay FROM DUAL
)
SELECT
  nd.ngay,
  TO_CHAR(sp.FULL_NAME) AS ho_ten,
  TO_CHAR(f.SHORT_NAME) AS ten_to_chuc,
  'CTCK' AS loai_to_chuc,
  TO_CHAR(
    NVL(
      (SELECT LISTAGG(cp2.POSITION_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cp2.POSITION_NAME)
       FROM SCMS_UAT.CAT_POSITION cp2
       WHERE cp2.ID IN (
           SELECT TO_NUMBER(TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(CAST(sp.POSITION_IDS AS VARCHAR2(4000)), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR)
         FROM DUAL
           CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(CAST(sp.POSITION_IDS AS VARCHAR2(4000)), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL
       )
      ),
      sp.POSITION
    )
  ) AS vai_tro,
  CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS so_cp_nam_giu,
  CASE
    WHEN sp.RECORD_STATUS = 1 THEN 'Đang hoạt động'
    WHEN sp.RECORD_STATUS = 0 THEN 'Ngừng hoạt động'
  END AS trang_thai
FROM nd
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SENIOR_PERSONNEL sp
  ON sp.APPOINTMENT_DATE <= nd.ngay
 AND (sp.DISMISSAL_DATE IS NULL OR sp.DISMISSAL_DATE > nd.ngay)
 AND sp.NATIONAL_ID IS NOT NULL
--  AND sp.ENTITY_TYPE = 'CA_NHAN'
--  AND sp.NATIONAL_ID = '45656666'  -- CCCD
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = sp.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID

UNION ALL

SELECT
  nd.ngay,
  TO_CHAR(sh.SHAREHOLDER_NAME) AS ho_ten,
  TO_CHAR(f.SHORT_NAME) AS ten_to_chuc,
  'Công ty chứng khoán' AS loai_to_chuc,
  CASE
    WHEN sh.SHAREHOLDER_TYPE IN ('CDL', 'CO_DONG_LON') THEN 'Cổ đông lớn'
    WHEN sh.SHAREHOLDER_TYPE IN ('CDSL', 'CO_DONG_SANG_LAP') THEN 'Cổ đông sáng lập'
    ELSE 'Khác'
  END AS vai_tro,
  sh.SHARES_HELD AS so_cp_nam_giu,
  CASE
    WHEN sh.RECORD_STATUS = 1 THEN 'Đang hoạt động'
    WHEN sh.RECORD_STATUS = 0 THEN 'Ngừng hoạt động'
  END AS trang_thai
FROM nd
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SHAREHOLDER sh
  ON TRUNC(sh.CREATED_AT) <= nd.ngay
 AND sh.RECORD_STATUS = 1
 AND sh.ID_NUMBER IS NOT NULL
--  AND sh.SHAREHOLDER_ENTITY_TYPE = 'CA_NHAN'
--  AND sh.ID_NUMBER = '45656666'
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = sh.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID

UNION ALL

SELECT
  nd.ngay,
  TO_CHAR(i.ITEM_NAME) AS ho_ten,
  TO_CHAR(sec.SHORT_NAME) AS ten_to_chuc,
  'Công ty Quản lý Quỹ' AS loai_to_chuc,
  TO_CHAR(
    CASE i.INSIDER_TYPE
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Cổ đông lớn'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Ban điều hành'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'HĐQT'
    END
  ) AS vai_tro,
  i.QTTY AS so_cp_nam_giu,
  CASE
    WHEN i.RECORD_STATUS = 1 THEN 'Đang hoạt động'
    WHEN i.RECORD_STATUS = 0 THEN 'Ngừng hoạt động'
  END AS trang_thai
FROM nd
JOIN FMS_UAT.INSIDER i
  ON TRUNC(i.S_WORK_DTE) <= nd.ngay
 AND i.RECORD_STATUS = 1
 AND i.ID_NO IS NOT NULL
 AND i.INSIDER_TYPE IN (1,2,3)
JOIN FMS_UAT.SECURITIES sec ON sec.ID = i.SC_ID
--  AND i.ID_NO = '45656666'

UNION ALL

SELECT
  nd.ngay,
  TO_CHAR(le.entity_name) AS ho_ten,
  TO_CHAR(cp2.equity_ticker) AS ten_to_chuc,
  'Công ty đại chúng' AS loai_to_chuc,
  CASE
      WHEN posx.vai_tro IS NOT NULL THEN posx.vai_tro
      WHEN cer.role_type_cd = 'NNB' THEN 'Người nội bộ'
      WHEN cer.role_type_cd = 'CD'  THEN 'Cổ đông'
      ELSE 'Khác'
  END AS vai_tro,
  csh.ownership_qty AS so_cp_nam_giu,
  CASE
    WHEN cer.active_flg = 1 THEN 'Đang hoạt động'
    WHEN cer.active_flg = 0 THEN 'Ngừng hoạt động'
  END AS trang_thai
FROM nd
JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.identity idt
  ON idt.identity_no IS NOT NULL
 AND idt.delete_flg = 0
JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.legal_entities le ON le.id = idt.legal_entity_id AND le.delete_flg = 0
LEFT JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.company_entity_role cer
       ON cer.legal_entity_id = le.id
      AND cer.delete_flg = 0
      AND cer.effective_from_date <= nd.ngay
      AND (cer.effective_to_date IS NULL OR cer.effective_to_date > nd.ngay)
OUTER APPLY (
  SELECT
    LISTAGG(NVL(lv.lookup_value_vn, p.position_cd), ', ')
      WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.appointment_date DESC) AS vai_tro
  FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.positions p
  LEFT JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.lookup_values lv
         ON lv.lookup_cd = p.position_cd AND lv.LOOKUP_GROUP = 'POSITION'
  WHERE p.legal_entity_id = le.id
    AND p.delete_flg = 0
    AND p.appointment_date <= nd.ngay
    AND (p.dismissal_date IS NULL OR p.dismissal_date > nd.ngay)
) posx
OUTER APPLY (
  SELECT c.ownership_qty, c.ownership_ratio, c.approval_flg, c.company_profile_id
  FROM GMS_IDS_UAT.company_shareholding c
  WHERE c.legal_entity_id = le.id
    AND c.company_profile_id = cer.company_profile_id
    AND c.delete_flg = 0
    AND NVL(c.ownership_date, c.updated_date) <= nd.ngay
  ORDER BY NVL(c.ownership_date, c.updated_date) DESC
  FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
) csh
JOIN GMS_IDS_UAT.company_profiles cp2
       ON cp2.id = NVL(cer.company_profile_id, csh.company_profile_id)
--  AND idt.identity_no = '45656666'

ORDER BY 1, 3;

-- Mạng lưới người liên quan
WITH
nd AS (
    SELECT TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 AS ngay
    FROM (
        SELECT LEAST(
            NVL((SELECT MIN(RELATION_START_DATE) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INSIDER_RELATION WHERE RELATION_START_DATE IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE),
            NVL((SELECT MIN(APPOINTMENT_DATE) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SENIOR_PERSONNEL WHERE APPOINTMENT_DATE IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE),
            NVL((SELECT MIN(RELATION_START_DATE) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_MAJOR_SHAREHOLDER_RELATION WHERE RELATION_START_DATE IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE),
            NVL((SELECT MIN(CREATED_AT) FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SHAREHOLDER WHERE CREATED_AT IS NOT NULL), SYSDATE)
        ) AS min_ngay FROM DUAL
    )
    CONNECT BY TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
)
SELECT
  nd.ngay,
  'NGUOI_NOI_BO_LIEN_QUAN' AS nguon,
  TO_CHAR(sp.FULL_NAME) AS ho_ten_ca_nhan,
  TO_CHAR(r.FULL_NAME) AS ho_ten_nguoi_lien_quan,
  TO_CHAR(r.NATIONAL_ID) AS cccd_nguoi_lien_quan,
  TO_CHAR(r.RELATIONSHIP) AS moi_quan_he,
  TO_CHAR(
      (SELECT LISTAGG(cp2.POSITION_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cp2.POSITION_NAME)
       FROM SCMS_UAT.CAT_POSITION cp2
       WHERE cp2.ID IN (
           SELECT TO_NUMBER(TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(CAST(rp.POSITION_ID AS VARCHAR2(4000)), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR)
         FROM DUAL
           CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(CAST(rp.POSITION_ID AS VARCHAR2(4000)), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL
       )
      )
  ) AS chuc_vu,
  r.SHARES_COUNT AS so_cp_nam_giu,
  r.OWNERSHIP_RATIO AS ty_le_so_huu
FROM nd
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INSIDER_RELATION r
  ON TRUNC(r.CREATED_AT) <= nd.ngay
 AND r.RECORD_STATUS = 1
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SENIOR_PERSONNEL sp
  ON sp.ID = r.SENIOR_PERSONNEL_ID
 AND sp.APPOINTMENT_DATE <= nd.ngay
 AND (sp.DISMISSAL_DATE IS NULL OR sp.DISMISSAL_DATE > nd.ngay)
LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_RELATED_PERSON rp
  ON rp.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = sp.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
 AND UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(rp.IDENTIFICATION_NUMBER), '[^0-9A-Za-z]', ''))
   = UPPER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(r.NATIONAL_ID), '[^0-9A-Za-z]', ''))

UNION ALL

SELECT
  nd.ngay,
  'CO_DONG_LON_LIEN_QUAN' AS nguon,
  TO_CHAR(sh.SHAREHOLDER_NAME) AS ho_ten_ca_nhan,
  TO_CHAR(mr.FULL_NAME) AS ho_ten_nguoi_lien_quan,
  TO_CHAR(mr.IDENTIFICATION_NUMBER) AS cccd_nguoi_lien_quan,
  TO_CHAR(mr.RELATIONSHIP) AS moi_quan_he,
  CASE
    WHEN sh.SHAREHOLDER_TYPE IN ('CDL', 'CO_DONG_LON') THEN 'Cổ đông lớn'
    WHEN sh.SHAREHOLDER_TYPE IN ('CDSL', 'CO_DONG_SANG_LAP') THEN 'Cổ đông sáng lập'
    ELSE 'Khác'
  END AS chuc_vu,
  mr.SHARES_COUNT AS so_cp_nam_giu,
  mr.OWNERSHIP_RATIO AS ty_le_so_huu
FROM nd
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_MAJOR_SHAREHOLDER_RELATION mr
  ON TRUNC(mr.CREATED_AT) <= nd.ngay
 AND (mr.RELATION_END_DATE IS NULL OR mr.RELATION_END_DATE > nd.ngay)
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SHAREHOLDER sh
  ON sh.ID = mr.SHAREHOLDER_ID
 AND TRUNC(sh.CREATED_AT) <= nd.ngay
 AND sh.RECORD_STATUS = 1
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = mr.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID

WHERE nd.ngay = DATE '2026-09-11'   -- NGÀY DỮ LIỆU
ORDER BY 3, 4;

SELECT * FROM (
    -- Tài khoản cá nhân (trung tâm)
    SELECT
        nd.ngay,
        f.SHORT_NAME AS ma_ctck,
        sh.TRADING_ACCOUNT AS so_tai_khoan,
        sh.SHAREHOLDER_NAME AS ten_chu_tai_khoan,
        sh.SHAREHOLDER_TYPE AS loai_co_dong,

        SELECT TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 AS ngay
        FROM (SELECT MIN(TRUNC(CREATED_AT)) AS min_ngay
              FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SHAREHOLDER
              WHERE CREATED_AT IS NOT NULL)
        CONNECT BY TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
    ) nd
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT sh.ID, sh.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, sh.TRADING_ACCOUNT,
               sh.SHAREHOLDER_NAME, sh.ID_NUMBER, sh.SHAREHOLDER_TYPE,
               TRUNC(sh.CREATED_AT) AS created_date
        FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SHAREHOLDER sh
        WHERE sh.RECORD_STATUS = 1
--          AND sh.TRADING_ACCOUNT IS NOT NULL
        --  AND sh.ID_NUMBER = :p_cccd
    ) sh ON sh.created_date <= nd.ngay
    LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = sh.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    WHERE nd.ngay = DATE '2026-09-11'

    UNION ALL

    -- Tài khoản người liên quan
    SELECT
        nd.ngay,
        f.SHORT_NAME AS ma_ctck,
        sh.TRADING_ACCOUNT AS so_tai_khoan,
        sh.SHAREHOLDER_NAME AS ten_chu_tai_khoan,
        sh.SHAREHOLDER_TYPE AS loai_co_dong,
        'Người liên quan' AS doi_tuong
    FROM (
        SELECT TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 AS ngay
        FROM (SELECT MIN(TRUNC(CREATED_AT)) AS min_ngay
              FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SHAREHOLDER
              WHERE CREATED_AT IS NOT NULL)
        CONNECT BY TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
    ) nd
    LEFT JOIN (
        -- Người liên quan qua người nội bộ
        SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(r.NATIONAL_ID) AS cccd_nguoi_lq
        FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SENIOR_PERSONNEL sp
        JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INSIDER_RELATION r
          ON r.SENIOR_PERSONNEL_ID = sp.ID
         AND r.RECORD_STATUS = 1
        --  WHERE sp.NATIONAL_ID = :p_cccd

        UNION

        -- Người liên quan qua cổ đông lớn
        SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(mr.IDENTIFICATION_NUMBER) AS cccd_nguoi_lq
        FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SHAREHOLDER sh2
        JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_MAJOR_SHAREHOLDER_RELATION mr
          ON mr.SHAREHOLDER_ID = sh2.ID
         AND mr.RELATION_END_DATE IS NULL
        --  WHERE sh2.ID_NUMBER = :p_cccd
    ) lq ON 1 = 1
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT sh.ID, sh.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, sh.TRADING_ACCOUNT,
               sh.SHAREHOLDER_NAME, sh.ID_NUMBER, sh.SHAREHOLDER_TYPE,
               TRUNC(sh.CREATED_AT) AS created_date
        FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SHAREHOLDER sh
        WHERE sh.RECORD_STATUS = 1
          AND sh.TRADING_ACCOUNT IS NOT NULL
    ) sh ON sh.created_date <= nd.ngay
        AND sh.ID_NUMBER = lq.cccd_nguoi_lq
    LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = sh.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    WHERE nd.ngay = DATE '2026-09-11'
      AND sh.TRADING_ACCOUNT IS NOT NULL
)
ORDER BY ngay, doi_tuong, ma_ctck;

-- Dashboard Lịch sử công tác của cá nhân ban quản trị, điều hành, cổ đông tại CTCK
SELECT
    f.NAME_VI AS ten_cong_ty,
    cp.POSITION_NAME AS chuc_vu,
    TRUNC(p.WORK_START_DATE) AS tu_ngay,
    TRUNC(p.DISMISSAL_DATE) AS den_ngay,
    CASE
        WHEN p.PERSONNEL_STATUS = 1 THEN 'Hiện tại'   -- Đương nhiệm
        ELSE 'Quá khứ'
    END AS trang_thai,
    CASE
        WHEN p.PERSONNEL_STATUS = 1
            THEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(nd.ngay, TRUNC(p.WORK_START_DATE)) / 12)
        WHEN p.DISMISSAL_DATE IS NOT NULL
            THEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(p.DISMISSAL_DATE), TRUNC(p.WORK_START_DATE)) / 12)
        ELSE NULL   -- Đã miễn nhiệm nhưng không có ngày miễn nhiệm → không tính được
    END AS so_nam_cong_tac
FROM (
    SELECT TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 AS ngay
    FROM (SELECT MIN(TRUNC(WORK_START_DATE)) AS min_ngay
          FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SENIOR_PERSONNEL
          WHERE WORK_START_DATE IS NOT NULL)
    CONNECT BY TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
) nd
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT p.ID, p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID, p.POSITION_IDS,
           p.WORK_START_DATE, p.DISMISSAL_DATE,
           p.NATIONAL_ID, p.PERSONNEL_STATUS
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SENIOR_PERSONNEL  p
    WHERE p.DELETED = 0
      AND p.WORK_START_DATE IS NOT NULL
--      AND p.FULL_NAME = 'Phạm Thanh Huyền'
) p ON TRUNC(p.WORK_START_DATE) <= nd.ngay
LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(CAST(p.POSITION_IDS AS VARCHAR2(4000)), '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS pos_id
    FROM DUAL
    CONNECT BY LEVEL <= REGEXP_COUNT(CAST(p.POSITION_IDS AS VARCHAR2(4000)), ',') + 1
) t ON 1 = 1
LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_POSITION cp ON TO_CHAR(cp.ID) = t.pos_id
WHERE nd.ngay = DATE '2026-09-11'
  AND p.NATIONAL_ID = '001168013381'  -- CCCD
GROUP BY
    nd.ngay, f.NAME_VI,
    p.ID, p.WORK_START_DATE, p.DISMISSAL_DATE,
    p.PERSONNEL_STATUS, cp.POSITION_NAME
ORDER BY p.WORK_START_DATE DESC;

-- Dashboard Lịch sử vi phạm của cá nhân ban quản trị, điều hành, cổ đông tại CTCK
SELECT
    a.SUBJECT_ID_NUMBER AS cccd,
    b.ISSUED_DATE AS ngay_quyet_dinh,
    b.DECISION_NUMBER AS so_hieu,
    c.DESCRIPTION AS noi_dung_vi_pham,
    d.NAME AS hinh_thuc_xu_phat,
    CASE e.STATUS
        WHEN 'NEW' THEN N'Mới tiếp nhận'
        WHEN 'PROCESSING' THEN N'Đang xử lý'
        WHEN 'DECISION_ISSUED' THEN N'Đã ban hành quyết định'
        WHEN 'ENFORCED' THEN N'Đang cưỡng chế'
        WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN N'Đã kết thúc'
        ELSE TO_NCHAR(e.STATUS)
    END AS trang_thai
FROM (
    SELECT TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 AS ngay
    FROM (
        SELECT MIN(b2.ISSUED_DATE) AS min_ngay
        FROM THANHTRA_UAT.PENALTY_DECISION b2
        WHERE b2.DELETED       = 0
          AND b2.ISSUED_DATE IS NOT NULL
    )
    CONNECT BY TRUNC(min_ngay) + LEVEL - 1 <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
) nd
JOIN THANHTRA_UAT.PENALTY_DECISION b ON TRUNC(b.ISSUED_DATE) = nd.ngay
                                     AND b.DELETED = 0
JOIN THANHTRA_UAT.PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT a ON a.PENALTY_DECISION_ID = b.ID
                                             AND a.DELETED = 0
                                             AND a.SUBJECT_TYPE = 'INDIVIDUAL'
JOIN THANHTRA_UAT.PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT_BEHAVIOR c ON c.PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT_ID = a.ID
                                                      AND c.DELETED = 0
JOIN THANHTRA_UAT.PENALTY_TYPE d ON d.ID = c.PENALTY_TYPE_ID
                                 AND d.CATEGORY = 'PRIMARY_PENALTY'
                                 AND d.DELETED = 0
LEFT JOIN THANHTRA_UAT.VIOLATION_CASE e ON e.ID = b.VIOLATION_CASE_ID
                                        AND e.DELETED = 0
LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SENIOR_PERSONNEL sp ON sp.NATIONAL_ID = a.SUBJECT_ID_NUMBER
LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_SHAREHOLDER sh ON sh.ID_NUMBER = a.SUBJECT_ID_NUMBER
WHERE nd.ngay <= DATE '2026-10-10'
--  AND (sp.NATIONAL_ID IS NOT NULL OR sh.ID_NUMBER IS NOT NULL)
--  AND a.SUBJECT_ID_NUMBER = :p_so_cccd
ORDER BY nd.ngay, b.ISSUED_DATE DESC;

SELECT pd.ISSUED_DATE NGAY_QD
, pd.DECISION_NUMBER SO_HIEU
, pdsb.DESCRIPTION ND_VI_PHAM
, CASE WHEN pt.CATEGORY = 'PRIMARY_PENALTY' THEN pt.NAME END HINH_THUC_XP
, CASE WHEN vc.STATUS = 'NEW' THEN 'Mới tiếp nhận'
           WHEN vc.STATUS = 'PROCESSING' THEN 'Đang xử lý'
           WHEN vc.STATUS = 'DECISION_ISSUED' THEN 'Đã ban hành quyết định'
           WHEN vc.STATUS = 'ENFORCED' THEN 'Đang cưỡng chế'
           WHEN vc.STATUS = 'CLOSED' THEN 'Đã kết thúc'
END AS trang_thai
FROM THANHTRA_UAT.PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT pds  
LEFT JOIN THANHTRA_UAT.PENALTY_DECISION pd ON pds.PENALTY_DECISION_ID = pd.ID AND pd.DELETED = 0 
LEFT JOIN THANHTRA_UAT.PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT_BEHAVIOR pdsb ON pds.ID = pdsb.PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT_ID AND pdsb.DELETED = 0
LEFT JOIN THANHTRA_UAT.PENALTY_TYPE pt ON pdsb.PENALTY_TYPE_ID = pt.ID AND pt.DELETED = 0 AND pt.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN THANHTRA_UAT.VIOLATION_CASE vc ON pd.VIOLATION_CASE_ID = vc.ID AND vc.DELETED = 0
WHERE 1=1
AND pds.DELETED = 0
AND pds.SUBJECT_ID_NUMBER = :p_so_cccd
